[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/15f986da2cd6c8fadde4ff8c0370f2047d9841ae.png[/img]
Today we're adding a variety of Leaderboards to the game - Ranked, Trooper, and Stats - to help players see where they sit in the world and compete against one another to get those top spots! The top section shows the top 30 positions in the world, and the bottom section shows your ranking and the players immediately around you.

[h2]Ranked and Trooper:[/h2]
The Ranked and Trooper Leaderboards show the positions of all players based on their performance. You can rise and fall through the rankings and is purely based on if you lose or win, with a modifier based on your previous 4 matches win rate. This allows new players to come in and, if they perform well enough, to climb through the ranks and knock off the more experienced players.

[h2]Stat:[/h2]
The Stat Leaderboards, divided into "Wins - Damage - Assists - Healing - Damage Taken", show the position of players based on their cumulative total in each bracket. The more you play, the more you contribute to your stat, the harder it will be to knock you off your position, so make sure to get your hours in if you want to be top of these brackets!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Camera and Cursor Options[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/f36ac73e7964004efaec936d8db3e9ac0bb383f0.png[/img]
There are 2 main changes coming today to the way that the camera and cursor works. High vs Low camera, which can be changed by scrolling the mouse wheel - and Locked vs Unlocked cursor, which can be toggled by pressing left CTRL. Let’s dive into what that means and how to customise the way you play!

[h2]High Camera:[/h2]
We’re calling the old way that players saw the game the “high camera”. This gives you the most information around you and gives you the true top-down feel of the game.

[h2]Low Camera:[/h2]
The low camera is zoomed in and angled up slightly, allowing you to see further in the distance and really zone in on your target. You are more vulnerable from behind though, so don’t be afraid to switch between the angles to fit the situation.

[h2]Unlocked Cursor:[/h2]
We’re calling the old way that you rotated the camera “unlocked cursor”. You do this by holding the RMB and dragging the cursor. This allows high fidelity plays with the ability to turn on a dime.

[h2]Locked Cursor:[/h2]
The locked cursor fixes the mouse to the centre of your screen, making it so that when you move your mouse your Trooper also rotates. There’s acceleration on your rotation, so moving the mouse a tiny bit will let you be accurate in your aiming, but if you need to rotate 180 degrees you can flick the mouse and will turn around in no time.  

[h2]Customisation:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/a941eda9f7b887f3dc71767261636f952420fa15.png[/img]
When you first load up the game you’ll be presented with this screen. You’ll have to pick the option you want to play with before being able to continue, but can always change it in the options menu. You can now also customise the speed your character rotates, so have a play and let us know what you think of the new ways to play!

We’ve updated the main menu music to a more battle-ready theme, and added in music to the loading screens and the squad select screen. You’ll have to play the game to hear it, but we’d like to think it’s leveled up the vibe of the menus!

notes.title: Three is the Magic Number - V0.01.20 - 22/10/2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7c91d69989d567823b40186c966f364e27928f1d.jpg[/img]


[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey all, we appreciate the patience over the past month and a bit while we’ve been working on the third abilities and reworking some of the core ability interaction systems. We're excited to get everyone's take on how the new abilities and ability interaction system is feeling, and what balance changes are needed in the coming weeks!

[i]A quick note before we dive into it: all match history records will be removed on updating, your stats will still be fine, but this is due to database restructuring.[/i]

There are 3 main aspects that will be coming in the next patch:
[olist]
[*] The core Ability Systems have been completely reworked, now creating a hard rule set for players to understand and play with. 
[*] The third abilities are coming to everyone, which will be increasing the interactions between a lot of the Troopers, and have been designed to complete each Trooper's kit and playstyle that you all know.
[*] We’re taking this opportunity to create a rough rule set for all Troopers ability order going into the future, so the orders of abilities are changing for all Troopers. 
[/olist]
You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] to help give us feedback! These actives will need some tweaking and balancing, so make sure to let us know what you think as that's the best way to have your input on the game.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Reworked Ability Interaction Systems[/h1][/u]
So a lot of this has happened in the background, so all of the abilities should work exactly the same as they did before, but now with more interactions! If something has a health bar like a deployable, then you should be able to do anything that you can to a Trooper as long as it makes sense. E.g. you can heal and buff Scorch’s turret but can only heal Eve’s Restoration rune, as it doesn't deal damage. All background systems now have a common root, so bug fixing for abilities should be a lot easier when someone reports it. Deployables will now also inherit the effects of their Trooper, so if Pan puts down a Teleporter, and someone puts thorns on Pan, then the teleporter will inherit the thorns effect.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Trooper Third Abilities and Ability Order[/h1][/u]
[h2]New Ability Order Rule Set[/h2]
Troopers now have a hard rule set as to why their Abilities are ordered the way they are - this will come with some new learning for our experienced players, but going forward it should make it easier for new players to change between Troopers! 
[list]
[*] Now Troopers will have their single target damage, or primary damage ability on Q, 
[*] Their secondary damaging, or enemy interaction ability on E, 
[*] Their utility ability on R. 
[*] Your purchased store ability will still be on F.
[/list]
Some Troopers do not fit into this mould, so cooldowns and ability rotations have also been taken into consideration in the ordering. 

[b]All of these can be rebound, so feel free to use whichever keys you want![/b]

[h2]Trooper Third Abilities:[/h2]

[/list]

[u][h2]Crow[/h2][/u]

[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey everyone! Today we’re bringing in some bug fixes to the game - smoothing out some of the edge cases around the Actives and general abilities. We’re not going to be pushing a patch over the next month as we’re working on something big in the background – Trooper Third Abilities! 

You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] to help give us feedback! These actives will need some tweaking and balancing, so make sure to let us know what you think as that's the best way to have your input on the game.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Trooper Third Abilities[/h1][/u]
This has been a heavily requested feature from the community, and they’re all being designed and made to really deepen the interactions between each Trooper and refine individual Trooper’s Kits and playstyles. This will require a rebalance of all Ability stats and Cooldowns, so it’s going to be a very big gameplay change!

Here’s some high-level examples of the types of Abilities we’re going to be adding in our next big patch:

[u][h2]Skull Crusher - Behemoth Slam[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/96a1ee472090bb263aac6a3deaf6346cc6e952f2.png[/img]

Skully slams down on the ground damaging all enemies in the area and creating a slowing zone on the ground around him. If the impact hits an enemy while they are stunned then they are stunned for an additional amount of time.

[u][h2]Nebular - Energy Wall[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/95f9274c933b63b66c7a125abfabf016a91d0fe7.png[/img]

Neb summons an energy wall at the cursor location which blocks all shots and movement. It has a healthbar, so enemies can destroy it to remove it from the field. 

[u][h2]Xandark - Culminate Wounds[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/c272b8e82b8051c63c23a34c5a761028a96dc4c7.png[/img]

Xandark spins on the spot, dealing minor damage to all enemies in a small area. If the affected enemy has any DoT effect, then it consumes it dealing a % of the remaining DoT as a burst of damage.

[u][h2]Eve - Divine Intervention[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/bb5081fe8912c89655eb4c18edb1bf622ed17524.png[/img]

Eve flies up into the air and dives down to an ally’s side. When she lands, she releases a wave of healing which gives all allies in the area a powerful HoT effect. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Lights, Camera, Action - Battlepass Updates[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/d85936109b67593399e3548d1517b5f15b28f82d.png[/img]

First order of business: we're extending the "Out of this World" battlepass for another week - until Thursday 2/09/2021 so make sure to get in your games before we go live!

The main piece we're happy to announce is the Lights, Camera, Action Battlepass which will be live Friday 03/09/2021! As you can see in the above image you can see the skins for Sarge, Fang, and Scorch, as well as some cool Podiums for you all to unlock! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]New Trooper Rotation[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/e232582f07de11c5fb7fb8984eda084ac6f10eb5.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Quality of Life Changes[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*] Passives and Actives now show on the store at the same time, rather than being in individual tabs
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*] Disarming Chords now affects multiple Enemy Troopers correctly.
[*] Marching Band end effect now triggers correctly at the end of the ability and on cancel.
[*] Minor Inconvenience should now no longer teleport you across the map in rare instances.

[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey all, today we're bringing out our first Trooper since Early Access - Pan! He's the mischievous Faun of the Fantasy Faction who plays the role of Support. We're also bringing in some visual tweaks and changes to a lot of the maps - however we're still collecting data on the actives and general balance at the moment, so nothing major changing this week! 

You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] to help give us feedback! These actives will need some tweaking and balancing, so make sure to let us know what you think as that's the best way to have your input on the game.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Pan - Support[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/ccbc2910244affb001b84cac7b87bacbf64030df.png[/img]

[u][h2]Marching Band[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/fb56d8783c7929cc28301da338a442f062de36ba.jpg[/img]
Pan plays his lute for 10 seconds, creating a 18m circle which follows him as he moves. Pan is unable to attack, but can cast disarming chords during the ability. Pan and his allies gain an additional 25% move speed and 30% damage while in the area. Pressing the ability again cancels it. 

[u][h2]Disarming Chords[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/64471f477ac3863743fe4a5fce3a70d395f9e58b.jpg[/img]
Pan strikes his lute, sending out a 8m long, 60-degree wave towards the cursor location. Any enemy hit by the wave is dealt 120 damage and is inflicted with “Disarm” for 2 seconds. This causes the affected enemies to be unable to shoot for the duration of the ability. 

This ability is a new archetype being added to the game - the cone ability. It dynamically reacts to the environment, shaping to the surroundings when you cast the ability, so you won't see effects going through walls!

[h3]Catch 22 [/h3]

[*] Cooldown: 30s

notes.content:

[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hi everyone, hope you've had a great week! Today's patch introduces our new Outta This World Battle Pass in which you can earn exclusive cosmetics for the Sci-Fi Faction, and Scorch will be breaking out of jail and coming back to the game!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Outta This World Battle Pass[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/05122d6b80f2b831c669c4ed2bdd9770dbfc5370.png[/img]
We've been in Early Access over a month now, and the Beta Battle Pass is coming to an end. We'll be introducing our first Premium Battle Pass which includes the Extractor Florp and Rocketman Glorgan costumes, the Presidential Nebular Premium Skin, their matching podiums, AND the new Alien Portal podium! All players will automatically start to unlock rewards from the free levels as they play, but to unlock the Premium rewards containing exclusive cosmetics you'll need to Go Premium inside the Battle Pass for 900 Super Coins. The Outta this World Battle Pass will run from [b]12PM UTC Monday the 2nd of August[/b] until [b]12PM UTC Wednesday 1st of September[/b].

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Scorch Breaks Out[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/f03a58b38ecd58a6b4dfdd4feacb807f2af7f03d.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/0e0c8f0533a5f1a0cdeff7a8e59fb84732ad5eb2.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Quality of Life changes[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*] Scorch's turret has improved particle effects including a bigger bullet visual - this is strictly a cosmetic change as the collision capsule on the projectile has remained the same
[*] Tweaked particle effects for several abilities and status effects
[*] Visual tweak to main menu top navigation bar
[*] Further improvements to the Bot AI decision making and movement
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*] Scorch crash fix - We have fixed all instances we can of Scorch causing crashing and can no longer replicate any issues in testing, however there are still rare reports of crashing which we continue to work on
[*] Menu focus fix - the main menu should now not lose focus when returning from a match
[*] Fixed Friends Invite icon
[*] Fixed Menu visibility issue
[*] Bug where bots would continue to act after match ends has been fixed
[*] Fixed issue where overhead UI would display the wrong colour
[*] Reduced instances of podium clipping through the floor at certain spots at match end - it does still occur in certain places which is a known issue
[*] Fixed podium material so they no longer sometimes turn transparent on end screen
[*] Fix for error popup during game - now the popup appears after the game finishes
[*] Tooltip for Xandarks backstab now has correct damage value
[*] Fixed Scorch's Hot Dog Skin turret projectile capsule size
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Known Issues[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*] You may have to restart the game to get your store to refresh correctly and receive a purchased item.
[*] By pressing the [u]`[/u] key (next to 1 on qwerty keyboards) you will enter an Ai testing mode. This has no in game benefits for players, but we’re running dev builds so we can debug the game. If you do this your camera can get disconnected from your character. If you do this in base you can get stuck in base.

[*] If you end the match with an ability being aimed, the aiming line/reticule will get stuck on screen. This can cause your abilities to lock off in the next game. If you have this bug go back to main menu before re-queueing and it will fix it.
[*] Borderless/Windowed/Fullscreen don't seem to be setting properly, working on a fix.
[*] We've had one instance of Trooper's spawning with the incorrect UI, we're keeping an eye out for this, but haven't had any additional instances of the bug.
[*] Some players are experiencing random crashes. Some of these have been fixed, but there may be more. If you experience this then join the discord and send over your log files to BadFox_Eddie. You can ask him how to get your log files and he'll help!
[*] Sometimes dodging can consume almost 2 charges if you dodge as your second dodge comes off cooldown – looking into this.
[*] Shooting the bus stops in game up close will block projectiles, while shooting from long range wont.

[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]

[u][h1]Discord Community Challenges:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/1c755da972552d0f2ca3f031974025fa8bbaa022.png[/img]
We’re introducing a daily community challenge for players to join in our Discord! Each challenge is specific for the day, and gives players the chance to earn cool content in game.
Here’s the breakdown:
[list]
[*] Monday Bot Domination – where the players with the most kills submitted that day can name a bot!
[*] Tuesday Pic of the Day – where the players can submit in-game screens that will be posted to our socials!
[*] Wednesday Winstreak – where the player who proves they had the longest winstreak of that day will win a podium of their choice!
[*] Thursday Player Giveaway – where anyone who played that day will be able to enter into a giveaway to win 200 Super Coins!
[*] Friday MVP – where the MVP (chosen by the BadFox team) will win a skin of their choice!
[*] Saturday Play of the Day – where the sickest clip submitted that day will be posted to our socials!
[*] Sunday Discord Giveaway – where we will be running a giveaway in discord for everyone to take part in for their chance to win 100 Super Coins!
[/list]

[*] Fixed an issue where the queue would bug out due to players inviting others to their squad while they were in queue.
[*] Podiums should no longer go half-invisible in the end match screen
[*] Bots in strike are now picking up keys correctly – so no more infinite strike matches if there was only 1 player on each team.

[*] We should have fixed an issue where players were getting stuck in vanity cam – let us know if you run into more issues with vanity cam.
[*] Scorch’s turret will no longer take damage from his own Rain of Fire. 
[*] Indignant PFX will no longer automatically happen when you spawn or buy it – it was purely visual, but it’s fixed.
[*] Berserker’s rage now triggers under 20% HP – as per the description.
[*] a fix for Skully’s reserves healing too much.
[*] a fix has been implemented to reduce the chance of the “waiting for 0 players” bug happening – let us know if you see any instances as the matchmaking process has a lot of edge cases.

notes.title: Max 2 Minute Queues, Region Lock, and The Abandoned Town - V0.01.04 - 16/07/2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7c91d69989d567823b40186c966f364e27928f1d.jpg[/img]


[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey everyone! We've been listening to everyone's feedback - our discord, reviews, and emails sent through to us - and there have been 2 main issues that players were experiencing. Long queue times in our off peak hours, and high ping when they were connected to servers not in their region. The following features have been added to fix these issues, and add more to the game:
[list]
[*] Introducing AI Bots filling queues, ensuring players get into a game within a maximum of  2 minutes,
[*] Region locking the game, with the ability for you to change your region to your liking,
[*] Fixing some very annoying issues that arose from players jumping out of lobby, 
[*] Adding a new domination map: The Abandoned Town,
[*] Tweaking and adding more detail to the visuals of our existing maps.
[/list]
You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] to help give us feedback throughout early access! You can also take advantage of our LFG role, and communicate directly with the Devs! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]AI Bot Queue Fill[/h1][/u]
The programming duo at BadFox have been working tirelessly over the past 2 weeks to work on AI bots filling matches for when there aren't quite enough players in the queue. We can now guarantee queue times are a maximum of 2 minutes. The first person into queue will begin a count up to 2 minutes, all players in the queue at the end of this 2 minutes will be put through to a match with bots filling the spare slots!

The bots filling player slots also allows us to fix some of the more annoying issues players were experiencing when someone quit out of the game when they were connecting to the server, were in squad select, or were travelling to the map. If someone doesn't make it across or quits out within a grace period of 60 seconds then a bot will fill the slot and the game will continue through to squad select and the match!

[list]
[*] There is still a minor bug that can occur when a player quite in a very small time window when you are travelling from squad select to the map. We're working on a fix for this, but you will have to alt f4 if you don't go through to the map after a minute or so.
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Region Locking[/h1][/u]
As we know that players will always get a match within 2 minutes no matter where in the world they are, we can now region lock the game. This will ensure that players have minimal ping when playing, so landing those skill shots will be that much easier! You will have a choice on what server you want to connect to though - so if you choose to connect to a server across the world, don't be surprised if you have some bad lag...

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Improved AI Bot Decision Making[/h1][/u]
The Bots general behaviors and movement has been worked on to make them feel a lot more like a player: 
[list]
[*] They move, group, capture objectives and chase down enemies better than before, we've been playing them a lot and they are a lot of fun to play against! 
[*] The Bots now also use (almost) all their abilities. Across the Troopers, almost 90% of the abilities are set up for the bots to use, with the rest to come further down the line!
[*] They're also not 100% accurate anymore, and instead have a deviance either side of the Trooper they're firing at that they can miss by. This means that they are a lot nicer to play against - but beware, because if you get too close to them you might just end up getting wombo combo'd by their abilities...  
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]New Map - Abandoned Town:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/2e5bf3285e8e516954273335a56a848f36370131.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/cd99907465805d084c590910490ec1b183173bf7.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Quality of Life changes[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*] Multiple map assets have been improved, adding detail to a variety of maps! I can't take screens of all of them, so you'll have to jump in game and see what i'm talking about...
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]New Trooper Rotation[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/e56446164fa325bbe0f268713d345c9f218b99a4.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[list]
[*] Your keys may be set randomly in the options menu while changing settings.
[*] Sometimes the escape key won't work when in various menus, right click on the game to re-focus the window, and ESC should work.
[*] Keys at Launch and Rockets diffused are not tallying correctly at the end of the Strike Match score screen.
[*] Sometimes key UI icons in Strike stay on the minimap after being collected
[*] Sometimes in squad select some players are given a wider aspect ratio than intended.

[*] If you end the match with an ability being aimed, the aiming line/reticule will get stuck on screen. This can cause your abilities to lock off in the next game. If you have this bug go back to main menu before re-queueing and it will fix it.
[*] Borderless/Windowed/Fullscreen don't seem to be setting properly, working on a fix.
[*] We've had one instance of Trooper's spawning with the incorrect UI, we're keeping an eye out for this, but haven't had any additional instances of the bug.
[*] Some players are experiencing random crashes. Some of these have been fixed, but there may be more. If you experience this then join the discord and send over your log files to BadFox_Eddie. You can ask him how to get your log files and he'll help!
[/list]

[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey everyone! We've been collecting all the feedback you guys have been giving and have made some changes and fixes to help alleviate some of the major pain points in the game at the moment. We're letting players browse the store while in queue, adding in AI bots that will play when someone DC's from the game, and fixing the dreaded ability bug that has been plaguing players this week! We're also doing some quality of life changes and additional bug fixes to help smooth the game experience.


You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] to help give us feedback throughout early access! You can also take advantage of our LFG role, and communicate directly with the Devs! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]AI Now Take Over if a player DC's:[/h1][/u]
Our journey to a fully-fledged Bot match has begun with the first iteration hitting this week. Now when anyone Disconnects from a match an AI will take control of the trooper. This AI is programmed to seek and complete objectives in both Domination and Strike. We hope this alleviates peoples' frustrations around DC's and will make matches feel fairer. 

This is not all on the bots and DC's though. We are gunning for full reconnect functionality allowing DC'd players to re-join games (This is no small task, so bear with us). You will also notice that the bots currently only shoot their weapons, using abilities will be coming real soon. Eventually, we will be taking these bots and creating a custom 5 Human vs 5 AI bot mod. Hopefully over the coming weeks you guys can see these bots grow in capabilities, give us feedback on where they aren’t great and help us get to the bot match end game!

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes - V0.01.00 - 25/06/2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7c91d69989d567823b40186c966f364e27928f1d.jpg[/img]


[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
First, we at BadFox would like to thank everyone who has come long for the beta journey with us. It’s been amazing to see people play the game and have so much fun! As a thanks for all of the help and feedback, everything beta players currently have unlocked will stay that way, so no free-rotation for you. You will also be keeping all of your Super Coins and Trooper Tokens for you to unlock future content in store! 

We’ve also heard from a number of our beta players that the weekends weren’t enough time to complete the battlepass, we will be extending the beta battlepass for 2 weeks after early access for you all to unlock everything!

Now to the changes themselves: For the last 2 weeks we’ve been focusing on quality-of-life changes, feedback, more badass moments, and bug fixes to make sure the gameplay is as smooth as can be for Early Access. We also focused on some new player guidance to help everyone just joining us get up to speed with the mechanics as quickly as possible!


You're welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] to help give us feedback throughout early access! You can also take advantage of our LFG role, and communicate directly with the Devs! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Overhead UI rework:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/2cf11785f2123e1918d30db0bcffe336978e156d.png[/img]
The overhead UI might look the same, but now there are various animated elements that help players understand what’s happening faster and make dealing damage feel a lot weightier! Now when Troopers take damage their overhead UI will fragment and break apart at lower and lower % health thresholds. This makes it much easier to understand at a glance who’s close to death and who you should prioritise! You will also see the dodge pips above the Trooper animate as they come off cooldown, helping to bring them to your attention. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Tips when Dead:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7012d1d70568907173b2ed0863f6c5d5da693db7.png[/img]
We’ve added some tips to the respawn screen after you’ve died. The tips are split into 3 different categories; General, Abilities, and Troopers. As you play more and eventually die, you will progress through the tips, meaning that new players will have general tips, then as they play more, they will get more advanced and niche tips for how to play the Trooper of that match! If you’ve had enough tips, then you can switch them off. If you want them back on you can go into the video option screen (ESC Key) and tick them back on.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]End Match Screen Overhaul[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/00f46a85b4aaac40bf716236fdc7e363dc231baf.png[/img]
We’ve reworked the end of match screen, now showing your Troopers in match on their podiums and showing the top Damage, Assists, and Tank (Damage taken) let us know what you think!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]The Store is Live![/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/3c57d1004c01c33e23033c9ce9d1f4898d0a2771.jpg[/img]
As we go into early access, we’re putting the store live! This means that you all will be able to buy Super Coin Packs to buy store content to help support us in making the game! Make sure to give us feedback on your favourite content to help us know the direction the community wants the content to go! Make sure to check out the Super Pack, it unlocks all Troopers current and future, so you'll never have to miss out on your Troopers in Squad Select!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Balance Changes[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/766b473340f6c833eccac188a0800eb3c1566f2f.png[/img]
[u][h2]Trooper Balance Changes:[/h2][/u]
[h3]Item Store Costings:[/h3]
[list]
[*] All Prices of items in the in-match store have been reduced to accommodate for the slightly shorter game time! 
[/list]
[h3]Florp:[/h3]
[u]Gun[/u]
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 46 to 43
[/list]
[h3]Flintlock:[/h3]
[u]Gun[/u]
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 56 to 51
[/list]
[h3]Eve:[/h3]
[u]Gun[/u] 
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 40 to 35
[/list]
[h3]Xandark:[/h3]
[u]Poison Bomb[/u]
[list]
[*] Explosion and Puddle size decreased from 15m to 12
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Quality of Life Changes:[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*] Focus, Knockback Shot, and Angelic Shot now line trace when withing 6m of an enemy, instead of firing a projectile. This should make landing these abilities at close range a lot easier!
[*] Now when you hit or miss with abilities a sound should play, giving players more feedback on hit confirmations.
[*] The cursor has been reworked to be clearer and give additional feedback when players hit enemies with anything. This applies to Damage over Time (DoT) effects, so even if someone runs away, you can still get the confirmation that you’ve applied your DoT effect!
[*] Focus and Angelic shot have increased Particle Effects (PFX) to further increase feedback on landing those abilities.
[*] Throwables now have trails! this should help with telegraphing these abilities and helping opposing players to dodge out of the way. This means that you’re going to have to play around their dodge charges to make a hit 100% certain, so think before you throw…
[*] Now when players have earned enough shards, they will be alerted through sound, minimap pings, a UI text alert, and an in world PFX and ring around the store itself. We were finding that a lot of new players didn’t realise there was a store, so we’ve added in a lot of feedback to help players understand when they’re able to use the store!
[*] UI has had sounds added to it in a lot of locations to help alert players when something is changing that they need to be alerted to.
[*] Work has been done to the cut-out material on a couple of maps to ensure that objects are see through when you’re standing in front of them. This is an ongoing process, so the more placed on the map are reported, the faster we will fix them!
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*] Now every time players connect to the game or finish a match; they will ping the server. We were finding that the frequency of our server pings sometimes meant that players failed a ping and then influenced what server their match chose as they could not connect to their closest game server.
[*] Rain of Fire should now no longer detonate in mid-air and not spawn the DoT decal on the floor.
[*] Guns are now no longer adding 1 damage to their intended total. All troopers have had their guns damage increased by 1 to reset the change 2 weeks ago to accommodate for this bug.
[*] Should have fixed a bug where Tharlin’s mines were sometimes not spawning.
[*] Throwable meshes should no longer collide with projectiles if they get stuck in the air – we’re working on fixing the throwables actually getting stuck in the air.
[*] Emergency Aid and Hunt the weak descriptions have been updated to reflect their actual stats – sorry about that one.
[*] We’ve reduced the number of cases where Suppressive Fire and Double O’s will not be interrupted even when Sarge or Flintlock are stunned while using the abilities. There seem to be one or two niche instances where this still happens, but we’re working through them as fast as we can!
[*] The BattlePass should no longer give you an error after you’ve completed it.
[*] We've fixed the issue where players were unable to dodge after getting stunned out of Suppressive Fire and Double O's.
[*] Sometimes your dodges will get stuck when going in and out of vanity cam,
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Known Issues:[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*] Sometimes Troopers can be stuck off of the map in Asteroid colony, this seems to be linked to being knocked off while using a channeled ability (Suppressive Fire and Double O's).
[*] Your keys may be set randomly in the options menu while changing settings.
[*] Sometimes the escape key won't work when in various menus, right click on the game to refocus the window, and ESC should work.
[*] Keys at Launch and Rockets diffused are not tallying correctly at the end of the Strike Match score screen.
[*] Sometimes key UI icons in Strike stay on the minimap after being collected
[*] Some players may not be given a vote on the gamemode vote, we're looking into this.
[*] Sometimes in squad select some players are given a wider aspect ratio than intended.
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey everyone! We're adding profile ranked system and MMR matchmaking, adding back in the in-game chat, revamping the UI, making changes to Domination, bringing some balance changes to the Troopers, and fixing some of the annoying bugs that have been plaguing the community. There's a lot coming into this patch, so we'll dive into it in the patch notes themselves!

Watch our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] throughout the weekend to take advantage of our LFG role, and keep the notifications on as we'll be running giveaways! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]UI Revamp:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/fae1a8415b21e0682658b082c489bd46920c66aa.png[/img]
We're changing the UI in Super Squad! This is for a couple of reasons; firstly, we wanted to centralise the Trooper and gamemode specific information at the bottom middle of the screen, allowing you to quickly get the information you need and giving us more space to put in a highly requested feature! Secondly, we wanted to give you more information on the Trooper's stats, aiding new players in their decision making, and helping players understand what's happening to your Troopers more easily. This should help you just have to look at one location while playing the game, so let us know what you think in our Discord! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Range Indicators:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/e2099f872fb385a34e95378126098ef6a7cfa620.jpg[/img]
While the above screen is quite chaotic, if you look at the cursor location at the top right of the image you can see a marker just below it. This is the range indicator for your gun! Generally speaking your range indicator will tell you your optimal distance to fight enemies, there is some nuance to this when taking some Troopers and their abilities into consideration, but that will come with learning what everyone does over a few games! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Profile Ranking and MMR Matchmaking:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/206b18de2ad2b67a0258e66fd4407efed129a1f6.jpg[/img]
Ranked is something that we're very excited to introduce to Super Squad! For the moment, we're bringing out a profile rank which will help you match with players of a similar skill level with you. This is done through a Match Making Rating (MMR) in the background, but will only really work with a larger player base. We also plan to add a ranked queue in the future, but that will come further down the line, but testing and refining of the system is needed before that comes into effect!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u][h1]In-Game Chat:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/3070464109373e6a0c99b05250f00bf3fb7fa03e.jpg[/img]
We're bringing in the in-game chat! We've heard you guys over the last couple of weeks and we agree on the importance of chat. It will not only let squads who aren't on voice communicate, but will also allow our more experienced players who are playing solo inform their team on different strategies and tricks in game, so make sure to keep your eyes on the bottom left chat box for communication!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u][h1]Balance Changes[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/766b473340f6c833eccac188a0800eb3c1566f2f.png[/img]
[u][h2]Respawn Timers:[/h2][/u]
Respawn timers will now get longer as the game goes on, increasing 2 seconds every 2 minutes. We’ll still have grouped respawn timers, meaning if you die and someone else has died you will respawn with them, but now as the game goes on you won’t kill an enemy Trooper and have them come back what seems like instantly.

[u][h2]Health Rebalancing:[/h2][/u]
The Troopers have had a small health reduction of 50 acorss the board, and 100 across the board for Tanks.

[u][h2]Domination Revamp:[/h2][/u]
Domination has been a favourite of our last few playtest weekends, but we’ve been finding that after a few hours the gamemode was feeling a bit flat. We’re adding a few mechanics to help add to the strategy of Domination, without making it too complex for new players to get into:

Kills now award 1 point towards your victory, and each capture pylon you control adds 1 to a kill reward. For example: if you’re controlling 2 pylons and get a kill you will be awarded 3 points towards your victory.

The longer you hold a pylon, the more points it gets you! Every surge a pylon makes for 1 team will increase that point's next surge by 5, with a maximum of 50 points. If the opposing team captures the point it will reset it back to 30. This adds a lot of high level decision making, while leaving it largely unaffected for new players, so make sure to watch your bottom of screen UI to see what points are most important throughout the game!

[u][h2]Trooper Balance Changes:[/h2][/u]
[u][h3]Skull Crusher[/h3][/u]
[u]Gun:[/u]
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 28 to 26 per shot
[/list]
[u]Reserves:[/u]
[list]
[*] Health threshold nerfed from 15% to 10%
[*] Duration nerfed from 10 seconds to 5 
[*] Healing soak buffed from 50% to 75%
[*] AoE ally healing buffed from 60% to 75%
[*] Cooldown buffed from 20 seconds to 18
[/list]
Anchors Away:
[list]
[*] Stun duration nerfed from 2 seconds to 1.5
[*] Cooldown buffed from 10 seconds to 8
[*] Initial damage nerfed from 130 to 100
[*] Impact damage buffed from 120 to 135
[/list]
[u][h3]Florp:[/h3][/u]
[u]Gun:[/u]
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 53 to 46
[/list]
[u][h3]Fang:[/h3][/u]
[u]Gun:[/u]
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 72 to 68
[/list]
[u]Fetch:[/u]
[list]
[*] Drag time nerfed from 2 seconds to 1.5
[/list]
[u][h3]Flintlock:[/h3][/u]
[u]Gun:[/u]
[list]
[*] Damage has been nerfed from 63 to 56
[/list]
[u][h3]Xandark:[/h3][/u]
[u]Gun:[/u]
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 47 to 46
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] Fang now no longer bugs people out when they’re being dragged by fetch.
[*] Vanity cam should no longer bug out people’s UI. – tested in engine and seemed to work, but let us know if there’s any invisible overhead UI.
[*] Flintlock’s Handsome Hellion Skin will no longer zoom you around the map.
[*] Abilities [b]should [/b] no longer get disabled. It seems to have been linked to latency, which is why a lot of our EU players last week were having it happen more frequently, as a large proportion of the games were on ohio servers.
[/list]

Hey everyone! With all of the changes that came with last week's patch, we're taking the time to help get everyone back in line with one and other - Eve, Sarge, Neb, and Skully had power levels over 9000... We're also bringing in a new map to the Domination gamemode - Martian Colony, as well as tweaking one of the chokes leading into the B on Asteroid Colony.

[u][h1]Domination Map - The Martian Town:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/5910d3ae44a66283e2840f781a0951e3d5a8caac.jpg[/img]
The hometown of Supreme Leader Nebular, the Martian Town is the place to be if you’re one of his many fans – or just looking to fill up your UFO. Head over to the Junker's Village to bask in the monument to our glorious leader, visit the gigantic altar in the center of town, or stake your flag next to the Flag of Earth in the historic tourist quarter.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Trooper Balance Changes[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/766b473340f6c833eccac188a0800eb3c1566f2f.png[/img]
[u][h2]Sarge:[/h2][/u]
With the change to Sarge's Cluster Grenade, last weekend he was a bit unstoppable... We're bringing the nerf hammer down on him as the win rate of matches with Sarge in them was a bit too high to be alright. The main offender of Sarge last weekend - Cluster Grenade - is getting a nerf across the board to stop sarge feeling too oppressive when fighting against him. In terms of raw numbers, this should bring him more in line with the other Troopers. 
[h3]Gun:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 22 to 20
[/list]
[h3]Cluster Grenade:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cooldown nerfed from 12 to 14
[*] Out damage nerfed from 130 to 115
[/list]
[u][h2]Skull Crusher:[/h2][/u]
Skull Crusher was in a good spot last weekend - although I said this the week before as well - the main thing that was causing skully to feel a bit too strong was his reserves. You could be fighting him one on one, and the frequency and heal total of reserves meant that, while he didn't usually kill you, it was nearly impossible to kill him.
[h3]Reserves Tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skull crusher damage absorption nerfed from 60% to 50%
[*] AoE healing buffed from 60% to 70% 
[*] Cooldown nerfed from 18 seconds to 20
[/list]
[u][h2]Nebular:[/h2][/u]
Last weekend Neb got a lot of changes, and most of the time he was fine... however, if you got a team that knew how to play around Psionic wave, he almost always turned the tides of a battle. We're rebalancing Psionic wave, and nerfing his gun damage a bit, to make it so he's really impactful, but not an automatic win.
[h3]Gun:[/h3]
[*] Damage nerfed from 63 to 56
[h3]Psionic Wave:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Battleflag cooldown nerfed from 22 to 24
[*] Attack buffs on standing in the area and allies standing in the area reduced from 25% to 15%
[/list]
[u][h2]Eve:[/h2][/u]
Eve was a bit too strong coming into last week as her gun range and damage were oppressive. We're also trying something a bit different with Angelic shot, we've reduced the cooldown and it's effectiveness, trialing our first "spammable" ability. Let us know what you think to the feel of it, as it will help to inform balance changes and ability design in the future.
[h3]Gun:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Range nerfed from 26m to 24m
[*] Damage nerfed from 47 to 41
[/list]
[h3]Angelic Shot:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cooldown changed from 9 seconds to 6 seconds.
[*] Enemy % Damage changed from 15% to 10%
[*] Ally heal changed form 20% to 13%

[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey everyone! We're bringing out a new Trooper - Eve - and revamping and rebalancing a number of Troopers abilities to ensure that everyone is competitive and enjoyable to play. We've also changes the way that Troopers move, speeding up the tactile feel of the game and smoothing out ability and dodge camera work. 

Watch our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] throughout the weekend to take advantage of our LFG role, and keep the notifications on as we'll be running giveaways! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]More Battlepass Levels:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/d2c4672927241768082f34e631e63d683536ed95.png[/img]

We're bringing in 4 more levels to the Battlepass, allowing players to unlock more content if they smashed through the levels last weekend. Now you can unlock 200 more Super Coins, 400 Trooper Tokens, an additional Gamer Podium- "Big Fan" -, and Heavens Champion Eve skin! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Movement System:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/37638eab0a32d0b3dd5f986b3386ddaa5beee332.jpg[/img]
We’ve changed the way that Troopers move in game. We used to be accelerating their movement, meaning that when you were trying to do some of those fine-tuned dodges you were lagging a bit when you changed direction. We’ve now put the movement speed of all Troopers at maximum acceleration, so you get tight movement when dodging. However, we're accelerating the animations and the camera so that you move fast, but the movement feels and looks a lot smoother! 

We’ve also fine-tuned the camera movement on things like the dodge, anchors away, being knocked back, and minor inconvenience to help give each ability or state that feeling of movement while it’s happening, and impact at the end of it. Long range abilities like hookshot and rain of fire also slightly raise the camera while casting them, to help give you that tactical information!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]New Trooper - Eve:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/d2fd6392d7e950235e10640bdfba29438c2efb4b.jpg[/img]

[u][h2]Stats:[/h2][/u]
Health – 948
Dodge Charges – 3
Move Speed – 6.96 m/s
Damage – 47
Range – 26m
Projectile Speed – 97m/s
Rate of Fire – 2.5

[u][h2]Angelic Shot:[/h2][/u]
Eve throws a magical ball at the cursor location with a range of 20m. If it hits an ally it heals them for 20% of their total HP, if it hits an enemy it deals 15% of their max HP as damage.

[u][h2]Restoration Rune:[/h2][/u]
Eve throws a rune on the ground at the cursor location within 22m. The rune pulses every 2 seconds and heals any unit for 50 health in a 12m diameter per pulse. The turret has 600 health and is destroyed either by depleting its health or killing Eve herself. When aiming the ability for more than 0.3 seconds, the camera will shift slightly up.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Gamemode Balance Changes:[/h1][/u]
[u][h2]Strike:[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/841925e53cc8169c6fb55a04c1c7c2f84647d438.jpg[/img]
Previously we increased the time to repair and downed time of the power relays by a couple of seconds, while this change was small, it seemed to make massive changes where players couldn't actually launch a missile. We're rebalancing these variables to help let players actually finish a match.
[list]
[*] Repair times are changing from 10 seconds to 8,
[*] Relay downed time changes from 8 seconds to 6.
[/list]

[u][h1]Trooper Balance Changes[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/766b473340f6c833eccac188a0800eb3c1566f2f.png[/img]
[u][h2]Sarge:[/h2][/u]
A good sarge player has been a menace over the last couple playtest weekends. His rate of fire has meant that once players learn how to track with him he can deal an insane amount of damage! This, combined with his ability damage, has meant that he’s been getting some great Kill/Death/Assist ratios. We’re slightly nerfing his gun damage to bring him in line with the rest of the Troopers, and reworking his cluster grenade to make it easier to hit the inner and outer explosions.
[h3]Gun:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 24 to 22
[/list]
[h3]Cluster Grenade:[/h3]
Time between the inner and outer explosions halved, meaning it’s easier to hit enemies with multiple grenades.
[list]
[*] Range nerfed from 23m to 20m
[*] Inner explosion damage nerfed from 150 to 110
[*] Outer explosion damage buffed from 120 to 135
[/list]
[h3]Suppressive Fire:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Speed nerfed from 13m/s to 8.5m/s
[*] When the ability is cast the camera will shift slightly up and angle back.
[/list]
[u][h2]Crow:[/h2][/u]
Crow’s damage and safety from knockback shot combined with the range of hookshot has meant that she’s been able to get some of the highest Kill/Death/Assist ratios in the game. We’re nerfing the range of hookshot, meaning that Crow players are going to have to be a lot more tactical in their positioning if they want to keep their safety. While the nerf sounds like a lot, the 60m was overkill, as the range from the centre of the screen to the edge is about 35m.
[h3]Hookshot:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Range nerfed from 60m to 30m
[*] When aiming the ability for more than 0.3 seconds, the camera will shift slightly up.
[/list]
[u][h2]Skull Crusher:[/h2][/u]
Skully's in a good spot at the moment, but there was a bit of UX on his reserves that needed addressing. It's always worked properly, storing up damage and then healing it back to himself and his allies at the end of the duration or when he's taken below 15% max HP. This meant, however, that when you activated the ability while on low HP it instantly went off as you were under the threshold. We've added a small amount of healing as a base to this ability to help it feel better when you're low HP.
[h3]Reserves Tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reserves works exactly the same as it did before, but now If the ability is pulled while under the minimum health threshold, then 200 base healing is done to everyone in the area.
[/list]
[u][h2]Nebular:[/h2][/u]
Neb was a bit too passive in his abilities and one of the highest picked Troopers for new players last weekend. We're reworking his kit to make him interact with the enemies more and give him more of a dynamic role in the fast paced nature of what Super Squad is today. 
[h3]Psionic Wave Rework:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nebular releases a wave of psionic energy at the cursor location, creating a high damage area that lasts for 15 seconds or until he dies. Ally Troopers within the area deal 25% more damage, and enemies Troopers take 25% more damage from all sources. When aiming the ability for more than 0.3 seconds, the camera will shift slightly up.
[/list]
[h3]Focus Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nebular fires a projectile at the cursor location, with a range of 28m which can hit allies or enemies. If it hits an ally then it gives them a 25% damage increase for 7 seconds, if it hits an enemy then it deals 150 damage. The ability has a cooldown of 12.0 seconds.
[/list]
[u][h2]Scorch:[/h2][/u]
Rain of fire was too slow in its old form, so we're allowing Scorch to move while casting and halving the time between casting and landing to help him keep up with everyone dodging around the battlefield. 
[h3]Rain of Fire:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Scorch can now move while casting the ability, and it lands in half the time it previously did.
[*] When aiming the ability for more than 0.3 seconds, the camera will shift slightly up.
[/list]
[u][h2]Florp:[/h2][/u]
With Eve coming into the fray, we can now start bringing down Florp’s healing amounts as he’s no longer the only dedicated healer. His speciality is still his mobile AoE heal on splosion, compared to Eve’s single target % heal, but the potential of double healer comps means he needs a bit of a nerf. 
We’re also reworking transfusion to work much like mysterious liquid, now throwing a grenade which gives allies lifesteal or enemies healing reduction.
[h3]Dodge [/h3]
[list]
[*] Max charges have been nerfed from 3 to 2.
[/list]
[h3]Splosion:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Heal amount nerfed from 380 to 320
[/list]
[u][h2]Tharlin:[/h2][/u]
Tharlin’s playstyle was always meant to be getting enemies low with your gun’s high damage, and then going in with your Minor Inconvenience to finish them off. The recent gun range reductions across the board seemed to hit Tharlin the hardest, as it was counter intuitive to his playstyle. We’re slightly buffing his range to help to give him back his old assassination potential.  
[h3]Gun:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Range buffed from 24m to 26.
[/list]
[h3]Burrow:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Range nerfed from 60m to 35 (35m is the edge of screen, so not really a nerf).
[*] When aiming the ability for more than 0.3 seconds, the camera will shift slightly up.
[/list]
[u][h2]Fang:[/h2][/u]
Fang was in a pretty good spot, however his kit lacked a bit of nuance a lot of the other Troopers had. We've added a defence up buff to smoke bomb to give Fang mains a bit more to consider before always throwing Smoke bomb at whoever they're trying to tag with fetch.
[h3]Smoke Bomb:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Smoke bomb now buffs allies for 30% for 7 seconds, in addition to slowing enemies.
[/list]
[u][h2]Flintlock:[/h2][/u]
Last week we updated the way that Trooper speed increases was done, this meant that the speed of Double O’s was a bit too fast for people to deal with, so it’s getting a nerf.
[h3]Double O’s:[/h3]
[list]
[*] speed nerfed from 12m/s to 9
[*] When the ability is cast the camera will shift slightly up and angle back.
[/list]
[h3]Mysterious liquid slight rework:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mysterious liquid has now been changed to a heal over time effect, rather than a straight heal. If an ally is hit or walks over mysterious liquid, they are healed for 200 Health over 3 seconds. 
[/list]
[u][h2]Xandark:[/h2][/u]
Xandark has been really strong over the past 2 weeks, but on paper she's very similar in damage to a lot of our other powerhouses. One of the main factors we could see that was causing this was the lack of risk while aiming backstab - players were just spamming the button until they hit someone. We've turned it into a teleport so that players now have to be 100% on committing to the ability before just firing it off - if you miss then you're in the middle of the enemy team and you're probably not making it out.
[h3]Gun:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage is 47
[/list]
[h3]Backstab:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Backstab has been reworked to now be a teleport. If you cast the ability then you will teleport to the target location. If you hit an enemy then the ability will work exactly the same as it did before, if you miss then you will just teleport to the target location, so be careful and no more spamming the ability to hit someone!
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] You should now no longer be able to get stuck in spawn in the urban battleground map,
[*] You should no longer be able to burrow or hookshot into a spawn zone and get stuck inside,
[*] The battlepass should now credit users properly when they unlock items,
[*] If you dodge charges get stuck recharging it should now reset after death or if you're able to do another dodge, we're working on a fix for this.
[/list]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h2]Known Issues:[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] Sometimes your dodges will get stuck when going in and out of vanity cam,
[*] It seems like bullets are sometimes colliding with each other.
[*] Sometimes Troopers can be stuck off of the map in Asteroid colony, this seems to be linked to being knocked off while using a channeled ability (Suppressive Fire and Double O's).
[*] Your keys may be set randomly in the options menu while changing settings.
[*] Sometimes the escape key won't work when in various menus, right click on the game to refocus the window, and ESC should work.
[*] Keys at Launch and Rockets diffused are not tallying correctly at the end of the Strike Match score screen.
[*] Sometimes key UI icons in Strike stay on the minimap after being collected
[*] Fang's fetch seems to be bugging out while it's dragging people - we're working on a fix.
[/list]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Steam Build ID: [b]6775762[/b]
To view this go to [b]Steam[/b] > [b]Library[/b] > [b]Right Click Super Squad[/b] > [b]Properties[/b] > [b]Updates[/b] 
It's at the bottom of the small pop-up window and is a way for you to ensure that you're game is fully updated and able to play in the test.

[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey everyone! This weekend we're bringing in a new map for Domination, some tester balance changes for all of the Troopers, and a whole host of bug fixes that you all caught last weekend.

Watch our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] throughout the weekend to take advantage of our LFG role, and keep the notifications on as we'll be running giveaways! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]More Battlepass Levels:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/be8e58024774a40dded312bd7332d8efcc9dd7c3.png[/img]

We're bringing in 5 more levels to the Battlepass, allowing players to unlock more content if they smashed through the levels last weekend. Now you can unlock 300 more Super Coins, 400 Trooper Tokens, an additional Gamer Podium, and Bounty Hunter Xandark! If you hadn't managed to unlock Gamer Boy Sarge then this weekend is your chance...

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Vanity Cam Changes:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/b40055a3214e45ed50c337fe08edd82727f10147.png[/img]
Vanity cam (V) now no longer lets you cast abilities or shoot – this was always meant to be a way for you to see your skins and Troopers, not as a viable play style, and gave some Troopers (Crow) an unfair advantage due to their gun/ability range.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]A New Domination Map:[/h1][/u]
[u][h2]The Underbelly:[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/882eb3f8e132e2b791b1e6f13ff30f30b5d19168.jpg[/img]

The spacious interior of this ship was specially designed to accommodate Skull Crusher’s gigantic frame, but all Pirates benefit from it. With a treasure room that dragons would envy, ample prisoner holding, and a tastefully decorated Captain’s cabin, this ship is the often hailed as the most prestigious vessel on the high seas.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Gamemode Balance Changes:[/h1][/u]
[u][h2]Strike:[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/841925e53cc8169c6fb55a04c1c7c2f84647d438.jpg[/img]
Strike was a bit too difficult to diffuse the missile sites last weekend, so we're changing some variables to allow for easier diffusing when working as a team.
[list]
[*]Repair time of power relays changed from 8 seconds to 10
[*]Downed Window changed from 6 seconds to 8
[/list]
[u][h1]Trooper Balance Changes[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/766b473340f6c833eccac188a0800eb3c1566f2f.png[/img]
[u][h2]General:[/h2][/u]
[h3]Gun Range:[/h3]
We've [b]reduced gun ranges across the board [/b]to test out how the more close quarters combat teamfights of Super Squad feels! From internal testing we found that it was an adjustment, but after a few games we really enjoyed it. Let us know what you think on Discord.
[h3]Health Regen:[/h3]
Regen used to be a flat 30 every seconds after not taking damage for 6 seconds. We found that for Troopers like Crow and Florp this was alright, but when playing a Tank the HP regen was too punishing. [b]Now, troopers regen health at 7% per second after 9 seconds of not taking damage. [/b]
[h3]Dodge Pips on the overhead UI:[/h3]
We're now [b]showing the dodge charges[/b] of each Trooper to everyone in game, this should give everyone more information regarding when they should commit to the fight and when they should back off.
[u][h2]Trooper Specifics:[/h2][/u]
[u][h3]Sarge:[/h3][/u]
Gun:
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 25m to [b]20m[/b]
[/list]
Suppressive Fire:
[list]
[*] [b]Speed decreased[/b] from 16m/s to [b]13m/s[/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Crow:[/h3][/u]
Gun:
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 45m to [b]36m[/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Skull Crusher[/h3][/u]
Gun:
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 26m to [b]21m[/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Nebular:[/h3][/u]
Gun:
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 35m to [b]28m[/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Scorch:[/h3][/u]
Gun:
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 30m to [b]24m[/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Florp:[/h3][/u]
Gun:
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 35m to [b]24m[/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Tharlin:[/h3][/u]
Gun:
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 30m to [b]24m[/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Fang:[/h3][/u]
Gun:
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 26m from [b]20m[/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Flintlock:[/h3][/u]
Gun: 
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 30m to [b]24m[/b]
[/list]
Double O’s 
[list]
[*] [b]Speed decreased[/b] from 15m/s to [b]12m/s[/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Glorgan:[/h3][/u]
Gun: 
[list]
[*] [b]Range [/b]is staying the [b]same [/b]
[/list]
[u][h3]Xandark:[/h3][/u]
Gun:
[list]
[*] [b]Range reduced[/b] from 25m to [b]20m[/b]
[/list]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] The Discord button, on finding match queue, now clicks properly instead of being slightly offset.
[*] Should have a fix for abilities getting stuck and stopping dodging and the use of abilities.
[*] Re branded the continue button to say 'rematch?'
[*] Fixed fang and trigger clipping in learn tab
[*] You can now esc out of the store instead of having to click the X at the top.
[*] Bullets will now no longer cause damage when the opponent is the other side of small obstacles 
[*] While casting Double O’s and Suppressive Fire, you are no longer slowed to base Trooper speed when affected by an ability.
[*] Pressing T will now no longer lock off movement – was the old chat function in the background.
[*] The Store UI overlay should not stay on screen while you’re outside of a store or in the menu anymore.
[*] The battlepass will now stop giving you levels after you’ve earned max battlepass rank.
[*] Fixed class icons staying after deselecting Troopers in Squad Select
[*] item store descriptions now should not flicker and stop showing you the item description
[*] Volume sliders should now adhere to what you actually set them to – remember to turn the game back up in your audio mixer if you reduced it!
[*] You should now be able to instantly click on settings as soon as you open the options menu.
[/list]

[list]
[*] It seems like bullets are sometimes colliding with each other.
[*] Sometimes Troopers can be stuck off of the map in Asteroid colony, this seems to be linked to being knocked off while using a channeled ability (Suppressive Fire and Double O's).
[*] Your keys may be set randomly in the options menu while changing settings.
[*] Sometimes the escape key won't work when in various menus, right click on the game to refocus the window, and ESC should work.
[*] Keys at Launch and Rockets diffused are not tallying correctly at the end of the Strike Match score screen.
[*] Sometimes key UI icons in Strike stay on the minimap after being collected
[/list]

Looking forward to seeing you all on the battlefield from Friday 7PM BST - Monday 1AM BST

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/6d64445bf866192daa36c9e87e0c18ac23f1403e.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Domination and a Squad Select and Learn Tab menu Revamp - 07/05/2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7c91d69989d567823b40186c966f364e27928f1d.jpg[/img]


[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey everyone! Today we're bringing a new gamemode to Super Squad - Domination - and refining some of the menus and transitions in game to bring the Troopers more front and centre!

Watch our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] for updates, as we're looking to expand on the work put out this week in the coming weeks!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Domination Gamemode:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/ae7c38df7bbd191abf98fa61db52fd9996429a44.jpg[/img]

We’re bringing back our old classic - Control, but been tweaked, changed, and refined and is now called Domination.  Players battle for control of 3 Pylons spread across the battlefield. Capturing the Pylon will award the winning team 15 points towards their win condition. The Pylons will surge every 30 seconds, awarding the controlling team 30 points. Race against the enemy team to get to 1200 points before them to win the game! Let us know what you think to the new gamemode, all feedback is appreciated!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Squad Select Revamp:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/8aa9b402d850fab323fa1010a166a19607d63cec.jpg[/img]
We’ve revamped the Squad select screen, bringing your team into focus, and allowing players to vote on the Gamemode they will be playing. You can also see the gamemode selection Top Left, make sure to vote to have your say on what gamemode you will be playing!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Learn Tab Revamp:[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/c7795483d50581d3a28314fd21bd054c1ae5657f.jpg[/img]
We’re bringing the characters front and centre in the learn tab, helping players to get to know who they’re learning about. We’re also going to be adding gamemode, class, UI, and control sections to the learn section of the menu to help players fully understand all the different parts of the game before playing!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Particle Effect Refinement:[/h1][/u]
A lot of the particle effects have been tweaked and changed to help all of them have a bit more flair and to aid in quick recognition when mayhem is happening in team fights. I'd recommend keeping your eyes on Xandark's poison bomb, it's one of my favourites...

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]Balance Changes:[/h1][/u]
[u][h2]Gamemode Balance changes[/h2][/u]
The end of match Trooper Token earning system has been rebalance for Strike. This should now help players get the rank that they should be getting from their performance in game!


[u][h2]Trooper Balance Changes[/h2][/u]
[u][h3]Sarge:[/h3][/u]
With the addition of Dodge charges and players getting more used to playing against him, Sarge's K/D/A and win rate has been falling. We're increasing the initial explosion damage to of Cluster Grenade to help players reliably get damage out, and rewarding those skilled players that can overlap the explosions even more!
Cluster Grenade:
[b]Inner explosion[/b] damage [b]buffed[/b] from 110 to [b]150[/b]

[u][h3]Crow: [/h3][/u]
Has been the problem child of the Troopers, having too much safety and damage to compete with… We’re nerfing her gun damage and Hookshot cooldown for the time being, with the aim to add damage scaling over distance in the future and rework her hookshot. This will mean that getting close to her will be the optimal strategy.
Gun: 
[b]Bullet damage [/b]has been [b]nerfed[/b] from 122 to [b]102[/b]

Hookshot:
[b]Cooldown [/b]has been [b]nerfed[/b] from 20 seconds to [b]25[/b]

[u][h3]Florp: [/h3][/u]
When used right, Florp is a must have to win games at the moment. The AoE heal can allow teams to stay topped up between team fights. As such, we’re nerfing the cooldown of Splosion. 
Splosion 
	[b]Cooldown [/b]has been nerfed from 10 to [b]14[/b]

[u][h3]Tharlin:[/h3][/u]
Has had a bit too much safety, zipping in and out of fights with burrow, and never really dying. As such we're nerfing his burrow cooldown to help players catch him out and take him down.
Burrow:
[b]Cooldown [/b]has been [b]nerfed [/b]from 18 seconds to [b]25[/b]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h2]Known Issues:[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] keys sometimes don't disappear from the minimap when they're picked up before landing on the Floor 
[*] occasionally you won't be able to use one of your abilities, we're looking into the cause of this and hope to have a fix for you soon. Try using your other ability and this usually fixes it.
[*] the camera aspect ratio may be incorrect for some users on Squad Select. 
[/list]
