notes.title: The In-game Store - 02/04/2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7c91d69989d567823b40186c966f364e27928f1d.jpg[/img]


[u][h1]Description[/h1][/u]
Hey all, I know I said we weren’t releasing a patch for a couple of weeks, but we’ve decided to roll out and test what we have at the moment and get some early feedback! Today, we’re bringing you one of the biggest gameplay additions we’ve had to date: The in-match ability store! 

Watch our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] for updates, as we're looking to expand on the work put out this week in the coming weeks!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h1]The in-match store[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/2aba7664f9e5671683bbf9b5cf605579eaaf5f0c.png[/img]

We’ve really wanted players to feel like they’re progressing in a match, scaling up in power, while minimising the snowball potential you see in other games as much as possible. As such, we’re implementing our take on in-match currency and a store to spend it. You can find the store either in your base upon respawning, or in one of the ‘contested’ stores in the map itself.

We didn’t want to just go down the route of stat increases and scaling, as the pace and vibe of Super Squad is a lot faster and more zaney, and we wanted to match that. While playing the game, you will earn Shards – our in-match currency – through various means* which you can spend in the store to get class specific conditional passives. These are effectively third and fourth abilities that the player is able to trigger through meeting conditions. We’ve designed the different styles as an aid to help players understand how each class can be played in an effective manner. All of what you're playing today needs polish, balancing, etc, but let us know what you think!

* “Various Means”:
[list]
[*] Kills
[*] Assists
[*] Pods Destroys
[*] Pod Assists
[*] Keys Collected
[*] Keys at Missile Activation
[*] Missile Launches
[*] Missile Diffuses
[/list]

Enough rambling though, lets get into specifics:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/2b1f850c7e98b5ce1ce627fd328715c71181dd39.png[/img]


[u][h2]Damage Passives:[/h2][/u]
[h3]“Kill Shield”[/h3]
Upon killing an enemy, the Trooper is rewarded with a 150-value shield. This shield is removed after 4s, or when depleted. If another kill is gained within the 4 seconds, then it is added to the remainder and the 4s window is refreshed. Shield is additional to health, so a Trooper can have more 'health' than their total.

[h3]“One-Two”[/h3]
Upon casting an ability, your next basic attack gains an additional 150 damage. The charge lasts for 6 seconds and is consumed on the next basic attack and, once fired, the passive cannot proc again for 12s.

[h3]“In-n-Out”[/h3]
Upon killing an enemy, the Trooper replenishes one of their dodge changes on Cooldown. 

[h3]“Hunting the weak” [/h3]
Whenever an enemy withing 30m is taken below 25% health the player’s Trooper gains a 25% movement speed increase as long as the “near death” Trooper is in the area.


[u][h2]Tank Passives:[/h2][/u]
[h3]“Berserker’s Rage”[/h3]
When the Tank is either dealt 15% of their total HP within 1.5 seconds, or is taken down to 20% max HP or below, they gain 15% increase to damage dealt and 30% reduction to damage taken for 10 seconds. This effect cannot proc for 20 seconds after the initial proc ends. 

[h3]“Rear Guard”[/h3]
When out of combat for 5 seconds, gain 15% movement speed increase. This is cancelled either, when this Trooper fires or casts an ability (not dodges), or an enemy Trooper causes any status or health change to the Trooper (damages, CC’s, debuffs, etc.)

[h3]“Indignant”[/h3]
When affected by hard CC, the tank gains 20% damage increase for 6s. This starts when the Tank is initially CC’d, so the actual up time of the damage increase varies. This cannot occur more than once every 10 seconds, and subsequent CC’s do not refresh the duration.

[h3]“Mitigate Foes”[/h3]
When 2 or more enemies are within 15m of the Tank for 5 seconds, gain 12% damage reduction for 10 seconds. Cannot proc more than every 25 seconds.


[u][h2]Healer Passives:[/h2][/u]
[h3]“Battle Medic?”[/h3]
If all abilities are off cooldown, the Healer’s gun damage is increased by 40%. Using an ability (not including dodges) immediately cancels this effect.

[h3]“Emergency Aid”[/h3]
Every 3rd dodge the Healer performs causes an 5m healing pulse at the end of the dodge distance, giving the Healer and any allies in the explosion a HoT (Heal Over Time) effect; healing 25HP every second for 5 seconds.

[h3]“Healing pods” [/h3]
This ability activates every 100 damage dealt to the enemy troopers. Whenever 100 damage is done, or an enemy is killed, the target drops small healing pods which either team can pick up once dropped on the floor. The healing pods heal whoever picks them up for 50 HP, however, if an enemy picks up the orb they are also slowed by 10% for 1 second. The Pod disappears after 8 seconds if not picked up by either team.

[h3]“Stun? what Stun?”[/h3]
When the healer is hit by hard CC, they are given a 150 shield which lasts for 3 seconds, or until depleted. Once the ability has procced, they cannot gain the shield for 12s.


[u][h2]Support Passives:[/h2][/u]
[h3]“Hold the Line”[/h3]
When allies are within 15m of the Support for 5 seconds the Support will activate this ability and the 2 closest allies gain a 5% reduction to damage taken and 5% increase to damage dealt for 10 seconds. This cannot occur again within 15 seconds.

[h3]“Trail Blazer”[/h3]
Every 3rd dodge the Support performs leaves a DoT effect on the floor along the dodge distance. This deals 30 damage a second for any enemy effect every 0.5s for 2.5 seconds, and persists on the floor for 5 seconds. Any enemy who is affected by the DoT and re-enters the area has their duration refreshed. This does not have a cooldown, and is only determined by sequential dodges.

[h3]“Backline Carry” [/h3]
Whenever the Support is awarded with an assist, give them 10% Damage increase and 10% movement speed increase for 6 seconds. This effect can stack up to 3 times if an additional assist is awarded in the 6 seconds. If the Passive ends, it cannot proc again for 15 seconds.

[u][h2]Further Work to Come[/h2][/u]
We do have some more things to add to the store, like the fourth Support Passive, consumables, and some Actives that players will be able to purchase; you can think of these as a third castable ability that are bound by your Class rather than your Trooper. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h2]New TAB/Scoreboard UI[/h2][/u]
With the new Passives (and future Actives) coming in, and the work we’re doing on the UI to help people understand how to play the game, we’re revamping the TAB screen. This now houses everyone’s kills/deaths/assists, as well as their Trooper abilities and chosen class Passives. They are also able to be hovered over to get information on how the Trooper’s in the game work, and what choices the players in your game are making.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h2]In-match UI reinforcement[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/863fd3dcb51bb621f9ca0ee40d737f1916b80743.png[/img]
We’re bringing the first portion of UI changes to help players understand more about the game faster. We’re adding in kill confirmation UI and we’re adding in some sounds to kills to help players know when they’re being a badass. We’re also adding in Ability hover overs, and keys to the abilities themselves to aid in understanding your Trooper faster.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] Changed the way that sounds are being played; they should now play at full length and dissipate correctly.
[*] Some background match making fixes, which should help smooth out match making.
[/list]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u][h2]Known Issues:[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] If a Trooper is picked in Squad select, you have to deselect them by clicking on them, rather than being able to pick a new Trooper by simply Clicking on them – this is legacy from 2 Trooper control, and will be fixed eventually.
[*] Sometimes the last tick of damage to a Trooper isn’t displayed properly/does too much damage – we’re looking into this. 
[*] Sometimes when a Trooper has been knocked into a wall, you are unable to shoot them – we’re looking into this.
[/list]



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

It's at the bottom of the small pop-up window and is a way for you to ensure that you're game is fully updated and able to play in the test.

notes.title: Hot Fix and Balance Changes - 26/03/2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7c91d69989d567823b40186c966f364e27928f1d.jpg[/img]


[h2]Description[/h2]
Hey Everyone, we’re back with some small clarity features, hot fixes, and balance changes after last week’s playtests. I know we said we wouldn’t be releasing anything for a few weeks, but there were some issues that couldn’t go unaddressed and some tweaks that needed to be done. We’re also sneaking in UI functionality updated to help players understand what their Troopers do!

We’ll be going on a couple weeks break from patches while we work the next major feature; our in-match progression system! Watch our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] for updates, as we’ll be teasing some of the mechanics that will be underpinning the coming change.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h2]UI Clarity Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/0612886fceb2fe6cbee239bad3f879e2a0dd2f4a.png[/img]
We’re updating the way you get information about your Abilities in Squad Select and in game. Where ever you see an ability icon if you hover over it a pop-up will appear telling you what the ability does, we’re planning on rolling this feature out into other aspects of the game, and including the enemy player’s abilities on the TAB screen to help new players quickly understand what everyone does.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h2]Missile Strike Balance Changes[/h2]
We’ve changed the way that power relays work to help limit the ‘get all the relays low, ignore the enemies, and one hit them with Sarge or Crow’ strategy. Now, when a relay has taken damage, but is not destroyed, it will not regen health for 6 seconds. After 6 seconds, it will regenerate health at a faster rate and up to 100%. The relay taking any damage will stop the regeneration.

Now you’ve got to actually take out the enemies before taking out the relays, with Troopers like Crow or Tharlin being key in keeping them from repairing with their advanced range. 

Let us know what you think, but in internal testing that change gave us some of the closest games we’ve had yet!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h2]Troopers Balance Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/766b473340f6c833eccac188a0800eb3c1566f2f.png[/img]


[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now, whenever you cause damage to an enemy Trooper you get a sound played to help reinforce the fact you dealt damage. We’ve also added this to dodging, hitting pods, and pinging the map. (You ping by clicking in the middle mouse button and dragging it in one of the 4 cardinal directions)
[/list]
[h3]Crow[/h3]
She’s still a bit too strong, so her damage is getting a nerf. We’ve got some fixes to come for her, but they’re part of some larger systems that will be coming in, so bear with us in the meantime.

Gun:
[list]
[*] Damage has been nerfed from 137 to 122.
[/list]
[h3]Nebular[/h3]
Neb is still being underutilised, we’re planning on changing how Battle Flag and Focus work (also Florp’s Transfusion) in the future. Take this buff for the moment, and we’ll revisit him in the future.

Battleflag:
[list]
[*] Damage increase buffed from 15% to 25
[/list]
[h3]Tharlin[/h3] 
Similar situation to Crow, bear with us.

Gun: 
[list]
[*] Damage has been nerfed from 118 to 103
[/list]
[h3]Flintlock[/h3]
Flintlock was feeling a little bit underpowered in the last playtest, so we’re giving him some small buffs across the board to help with his duellist’s potential.

Health:
[list]
[*] has been buffed to from 969 to 1039
[/list]
Double O’s:
[list]
[*] Speed increased from 14m/s to 15
[*] Damage Reduction buffed from 15% to 25
[/list]
[h3]Fang[/h3]
There was a bug where Fang's Smoke Bomb was affecting Troopers outside of the visual area of the PFX, that's now fixed.

Fetch:
[list]
[*] Fixed smoke bomb overlap size, now the PFX and the overlap line up properly.
[/list]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that caused the match-finding to bug out last playtest – it centered around match finding timer, but it’s all fixed now so no need to worry about it!
[*] Fixed some squad up bugs we were seeing last week.
[*] Dodges now no longer override speed buffs/debuffs – now if your movement speed will stay what it is meant to be even while you’re dodging.
[*] Key pods now correctly take buffed (from abilities) gun and ability damage
[*] You should now no longer be able to get into the enemy base when they respawn.
[*] Ability descriptions now are updated and correctly describe what the abilities do – was some legacy stuff from when we changed abilities in the past.
[*] Dead units no longer repair power relays if they die while standing on them.
[/list]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Keys appearing on the map when a Trooper kills an enemy with keys and picks them up before they hit the Floor.
[*] Sometimes you can’t hit a Trooper when they’re pushed up directly next to specific pieces of the environment – looking into this.
[/list]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: The Ping Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7c91d69989d567823b40186c966f364e27928f1d.jpg[/img]


[h2]Description[/h2]
Hey everyone! Throughout the last couple of weeks we’ve heard the need for non-voice chat communications, so we’re bringing our take on a ping system to help players strategies and communicate in the heat of battle! We're also doing some further balance changes and fixing some bugs that have been breaking some Troopers. 

We’ll be going on a few weeks break from patches while we work the next major feature; our in-match progression system! Watch our [url=https://discord.gg/CpeWtdeb7m  ][b]Discord [/b][/url] for updates, as we’ll be teasing some of the mechanics that will be underpinning the coming change.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h2]Smart Ping[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/e9e53871c0815bad93d80158e19174bd59345664.jpg[/img]
The smart ping system allows players to click the middle mouse button and drag the mouse in one of the cardinal directions to temporarily mark the map with - “Attack, Defend, Retreat, or Help”.  If you perform this action on the ground, it will mark it for 5 seconds. If you do this on a power relay, key pod, ally, or enemy it will encircle them and, if they move, it will follow them for 5 seconds. You cannot use more than five pings in a five second window, so there’s a limit to spamming the ping function.

The ping key is re-bindable in the options menu on the main menu or in the esc menu in-match.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Troopers Balance Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/766b473340f6c833eccac188a0800eb3c1566f2f.png[/img]


[h3]Crow[/h3]
Crow’s dominating when used by our higher skill cap players, so we’re reducing her gun damage slightly to bring her in line with the other Troopers and make her less oppressive.

Gun:
[list]
[*] Damage has been nerfed from 144 to 137.
[/list]
[h3]Nebular[/h3]
Neb wasn’t getting a lot of love, this is in part to the static nature of Battle Flag. As a stop gap, we’re going to be buffing his gun damage to help him be more impactful in fights, with the aim to rework Battle Flag in the future.

Gun:
[list]
[*] Damage has been buffed from 57 to 63
[/list]
[h3]Florp[/h3] 
Florp recently has been a bit broken. This was because the Deepshorian Florp skin was double proccing Splosion. However, we were seeing that base Florp players were not doing too well in general. So, we’re buffing his damage and healing of splosion slightly to help keep florp competitive as our only Healer at the moment.

Splosion: 
[list]
[*] Damage has been buffed from 220 to 250 
[*] Healing has been buffed from 350 to 380
[/list]
[h3]Scorch[/h3]
Last week Rain of Fire was feeling good, but Scorche’s turret was feeling a bit underwhelming when player’s understood how to deal with it effectively. As such, we’re buffing the base damage of his Turret’s bullets.

Deploy Turret:
[list]
[*] Base bullet damage has been buffed from 8 to 12 damage per shot
[/list]
[h3]Flintlock[/h3]
Flintlock’s speed increase of Double O’s was a bit too high to be fair, so we’re nerfing it.

Double O’s:
[list]
[*] Speed decrease from 15m/s to 14m/s
[/list]
[h3]Xandark[/h3]
Last week to took the DoT effect from Backstab, she needed some further tweaks to her balance to bring her in line with the other Troopers. We hear everyone that they think Xandark is a bit OP at the moment, so we're keeping an eye on her performance in the coming weeks. 
Keeping her at range is her best counter at the moment as she has the second lowest health in the game and her Backstab and Throwing Knives has some of the shortest range in the game.

Backstab:
[list]
[*] Damage has been buffed from 180 to 210
[/list]
Poison Bomb:
[list]
[*] Cooldown has been nerfed from 22 seconds to 24
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sarge and Flintlock can no longer dash during Suppressive Fire or Double O’s.
[*] Florp will no longer deal double damage and healing with Splosion.
[*] Players should no longer spawn in at the start of the game with key pods already on the map.
[*] Players can no longer move during the starting explanation cutscene.
[*] Players should no longer get red or blue screens when transitioning between the stages of going into the game.
[*] The match found sound should now play when you’re tabbed out of the Super Squad window.
[*] Mysterious liquid and spolsion should now no longer proc on dead allies and enemies.
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Keys appearing on the map when a Trooper kills an enemy with keys and picks them up before they hit the Floor.
[*] Sometimes Troopers can be locked in spawn – looking into this – an ally has to die to unlock the spawn zone. 
[*] Sometimes you can’t hit a Trooper when they’re pushed up directly next to specific pieces of the environment – looking into this.
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Playtest Hot Fixes and Balance Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7c91d69989d567823b40186c966f364e27928f1d.jpg[/img]


[h2]Description[/h2]
Last week’s playtest gave us a lot of data to play with to help balance out our new gamemode and bring the Troopers in line with each other. So, a big thank you and without further ado let’s get to the patch notes!


[h2]General Balance Changes [/h2]

[h3]Grouped Respawn Timers[/h3]
In our last playtest we saw a lot of people running into the enemy team on their own and continuously dying. To address this, the Troopers will respawn in groups if they die within a short window of each other. The first Trooper from a team to die starts their team’s 8 second respawn timer, any other Trooper who dies in that 8s window will respawn with their teammates. The idea here is to get everyone grouping up and not running into an enemy team on their own (and getting merc’d).

[h3]Throwable Ability Preview[/h3]
For a while now we’ve been seeing players throwing abilities into walls and not realising they had done so, resulting in confusion and annoyance that the ability had been wasted. The communication wasn’t there and this wasn’t terribly fun. We’ve changed the way that throwable abilities work and aim: now when aiming at something that would consume the ability, a red X appears on the cursor and the floor decal disappears. If you release the key while the X is up the ability will not cast.

This has been applied to everything apart from Sarge’s Cluster Grenade, as there are some plays to be made in hitting the environment and raining down grenades on the surrounding area.

This feature is still being worked on and refined, so if anything feels or looks wrong let us know so we can adjust the system!


[h2]Missile Strike Balance Changes[/h2]
We found that attacking the missile silos was a bit too difficult, so we’re adding in some mechanics and tweaking some numbers to try and bring the attack/defend phase of missile strike into a more balanced state. We’re probably going to see the attackers have an advantage in this hot-fix but this will give us two ends of the spectrum to balance between, so bear with us as we test during our beta phase!

[h3]Relay Downed Window:[/h3]
Relays now have a 6 second window after being destroyed where they are not repairable. This should give the attackers a bigger window to take the others down and abort the launch.

[h3]Relay Regen Speed:[/h3]
To help defenders fight back against these tweaks, damaged relays will now auto-regenerate their health much faster.


[h2]Troopers Balance Changes[/h2]
We’re making some quality-of-life changes to abilities in this patch, as well as giving our tanks some love to help them fit into their role a bit better. Let’s dive into the individual Troopers:


[h3]Crow[/h3]
Overall Crow’s in a good spot at the moment – being very squishy but dealing all the damage. However, Hookshot’s cooldown was a bit too low, giving her too much safety in combat and allowing her to collect and hold keys better than everyone else in the game (apart from Tharlin).

Hookshot:
[list]
[*] The cooldown has been nerfed from 18 seconds to 20.
[/list]

[h3]Skull Crusher[/h3]
Skully and the rest of the tanks were feeling a bit squishier than we would like in our last playtest, so we’re buffing his Health and tweaking some of his abilities to make him a more viable pick. 

Health:
[list]
[*] Health has been buffed from 1368 to 1618
[/list]
Reserves: 
[list]
[*] Damage stored has been buffed from 40% to 60%
[*] AoE heal has been nerfed from 70% to 60%
[*] Health trigger threshold nerfed from 20% to 15%
[*] Cooldown has been nerfed from 13 seconds to 18
[/list]
Anchors Away: 
[list]
[*] Anchors Away damage on stun has been nerfed from 150 to 130
[*] Cooldown has been buffed from 12 seconds to 10
[/list]

[h3]Scorch[/h3] 
Scorch’s Rain of Fire was pretty useful to lock down areas of the map, but it was almost impossible to actually hit someone with it (unless the target wasn’t paying attention). To fix this, we’re bringing down the time between casting the ability and it hitting the ground.

Rain of Fire: 
[list]
[*] Time between casting and fireball hitting the ground has been buffed from 2 seconds to 1.
[/list]

[h3]Tharlin[/h3]
Tharlin’s win rate and damage were both a bit too high. His gun damage and range were too much, the damage of Minor Inconvenience was too powerful, and Burrow’s cooldown was too short. All of this combined turned Tharlin into a powerhouse that not many other Troopers could compete with, so he’s getting nerfs across the board to bring him in line with the other Troopers. Sorry, Tharlin mains!

Gun Range:
[list]
[*] Range has been nerfed from 40m to 30m
[/list]
Minor Inconvenience:
[list]
[*] Damage of each individual mine has been nerfed from 140 damage to 115
[/list]
Burrow:
[list]
[*] Burrow’s cooldown has been nerfed from 15 seconds to 17
[/list]

[h3]Fang[/h3]
Fang and the rest of the Tanks were feeling a bit underwhelming, so his Health and Fetch ability are getting a buff. We also want to rework how Smoke Bomb works in the near future, giving Fang more utility.

Health:
[list]
[*] Health has been buffed from 1163 to 1413
[/list]
Fetch:
[list]
[*] We’ve taken out the damage reduction which was given to targets as they were being dragged, so now they take 100% damage from all sources. 
[/list]

[h3]Glorgan[/h3]
Glorgan was a bit of a hidden danger in the roster; though his pick rate wasn’t that great, his damage output and win rate were higher than they should be. We’re giving him a nerf across the board to bring him more in line with the other Troopers and giving his Health a buff to bring him in line with the other Tank’s new HP.

Health:
[list]
[*] Health has been buffed from 1196 to 1396
[/list]
Move Speed:
[list]
[*] Move speed has been nerfed from 7.2 m/s to 7.0
[/list]
Overcharge:
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed from 250 to 200
[/list]
Rallying Call
[list]
[*] Speed increase nerfed from 20% to 12%
[/list]

[h3]Xandark[/h3]
Xandark was an absolute menace in last week’s test, with a win rate and damage output too high for everyone else to deal with. The main aspect of her kit that seemed to be unbalanced was the combined double DoT effects, as well as the teleport power of Back Stab. We want to try removing the DoT from backstab before we do any bigger changes to how her kit works to see what the numbers look like.

Backstab:
[list]
[*] The DoT effect has been removed from backstab, so now it’s just a burst of damage. 
[/list]

[h2]Hot Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Dodge should now end correctly when your Trooper is CC’d or dies.
[*] The Matchmaking Accept/Reject screen now has sound and an animated visual side to help players know when they’ve found a match. This will not play when the game is minimised, we won’t have this functionality until we have source engine files.
[*] Pressing J and K no longer instantly kills the Player’s Trooper (whoops!)
[/list]

AoE heal has been nerfed from 70% to 60%
Health trigger threshold nerfed from 20% to 15%

Anchors Away damage on stun has been nerfed from 150 to 130

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/7c91d69989d567823b40186c966f364e27928f1d.jpg[/img]

[h2]First of All…[/h2]
We’d like to thank everyone who participated in our first phase of beta testing, we got tons of really useful data and feedback that have informed the changes you’ll be seeing this patch. We look forward to this round of tests and your continued support in helping us keep refining the game through your feedback!


[h2]Description[/h2]
In this patch we’re making a lot of big changes which we’re excited to get your guys feedback on! You’re now only controlling 1 Trooper, we’ve overhauled the gameplay, rebalanced all of the Troopers, there’s a whole new gamemode which is replacing control, and there’s some main menu and matchmaking changes. Let’s get into some specifics.


[h2]Then there was One…[/h2]
Our last round of testing had players controlling 2 Troopers. This was really fun, and incredibly rewarding once you got the hang of it, but we found that a lot of players were not getting to enjoy Super Squad at its full potential as there was too steep of a learning curve when coming up against our seasoned players. 
We played around with a couple of different solutions before deciding to run with players controlling 1 Trooper in teams of 5. The reason for this direction is that we found that you could now fully focus on your single Trooper’s mechanics, getting into higher fidelity dog fights, and getting that Trooper combo potential through your team’s synergies and coordination. 
The change also allowed us to really lean into the Shoot-em-up aspect of the game, adding in our new dodge mechanic and honing the fast paced and frenetic aspect of the game as your 1 Trooper now has your undivided attention, but we can get more into that during the gameplay overhaul section. 


[h2]Gameplay Overhaul [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/455d49380651a0928ca93f9db43740f135b115bd.jpg[/img]
Now that some of your brain is freed up from micro-managing those 2 Troopers, we wanted to add in some complexity and fidelity to other aspects of the game and refine some of the old mechanics we found players weren’t really engaging with.

[h3]The Dodge[/h3]
We’ve added a new mechanic – ‘the dodge’ – to the game which is bound to the SPACEBAR. Each Trooper will have a specific number of dodge charges they will be able to use, however, the distance and cooldown is standardised across all Troopers. The idea behind this is to pick up the pace of combat, allowing players to watch for key CC or damage incoming and quickly dodge out of the way of the danger.

[h3]Armour and Shield - Cut[/h3]
Each Trooper used to either have armour, shield, or flat damage and a mix of armour and health, or shield and health as their defensive stats. While this added a lot of high level counterplay potential, even our best players were ignoring this system.
[b]Now Troopers have been simplified, just having health, and allowing for players to stay in the moment and really focus on positioning and potential danger for their target prioritisation.[/b]

[h3]Removed Empowered Abilities – Cut[/h3]
Each Trooper used to be able to charge their next ability through landing basic attacks. This would cause their next cast ability to have increased stats and a bigger, more impactful particle effect. While this was cool, we found that most players were confused as to what an empowered ability was and how to use it. 
[b]We’ve removed the empowered abilities so that players do not have to wait for the meter to be filled, and can really focus on how to best use their abilities from second to second.[/b]


[h2]Trooper Rebalancing[/h2]
As we’ve removed the second Trooper, added the dodge, and cut some of the more fiddley or confusing mechanics, we’ve created the space for the game to be faster, more engaging, and higher fidelity. 
[list]
[*] All the Troopers have had their movement and projectile speed increased to lean into the high paced shoot-em-up feel of Super Squad. 
[*] All health values have been reduced and rebalanced to raise the stakes of every fight. 
[*] All abilities stats and travel times have been rebalanced to fit in with the new speed of the game.
[*] All damage increase buffs now apply to bullet and abilities, where they used to only apply to 
bullets, to give our supports some love.
[/list]
For any specifics, go to the Trooper Tab on the Main Menu to learn more about the current state of each individual Trooper.


[h2]Missile Strike – the New Control[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/d6c76b31256eaf32c4e4f5debdff0e2a1ecc5225.jpg[/img]
Now that there’s less mechanically to worry about in controlling your Trooper, we’ve added some complexity back into the gamemode. We’ve introduced a new gamemode ‘Missile Strike’ to replace our old gamemode – Control. 
This pits teams of 5 against one another in a battle to launch missiles at each other’s base. To activate a missile a team has to collect keys from pods that drop around the map; once a team has 10 a missile silo will activate on a map for them to defend until launch. The opposing team has to attack power relays around the silo to try and deactivate the missile and abort the launch – all 4 relays must be down at once to abort the launch. Once one team has hit the enemy base twice, they win the game!
Make sure to pay attention to the start a match, as you will be given a short fly through of some key aspects of the gamemode and told how to play. You will also be reminded of what your current objective is in your objective box on the left of the screen.


[h2]Main Menu Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/4ab94e0831b16a215fd55133a39ab1d0fa10a0e4.jpg[/img]
Our main menu screen has had an overhaul, now featuring a missile site, with the corresponding power relays, as the main feature. If you sit back and watch you can watch one of the missiles launch in the background! 
We’ve also added in a rating bar at the bottom of the screen which will pop up after your first game after every patch release. Make sure to give us feedback on the current patch through that star rating as it will help us to track how each patch is generally received by the community.
You can now see the Build ID at the bottom left corner of the window before you connect to the main menu - otherwise right-click on Super Squad, go to properties, click local files, and you should see your Build ID there.
This patch's Build ID is 6330490


[h2]Matchmaking Changes [/h2]
When you press play and the game find’s a match you’ll have to click accept. If you miss the time window to accept you will be put back onto the main menu, so make sure to watch your screen. 
We’ve also done a large amount of back-end work on the matchmaking queue to help refine the experience and reduce the amount of bugs that players experience. 


[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you find your Trooper stuck, check your keybindings on the options menu using the esc key in game. We’re having an issue where sometimes keybindings reset mid-game – we’re working on it.
[*] If Xandark backstabs someone inside of poison bomb or Rain of Fire, the DoT effect from the AoE effect persists until death. Please don’t abuse this bug. 
[*] Sometimes when a Trooper dies and drops keys in missile strike their dropped keys are left on the minimap after another Trooper has picked them up. 
[*] Earning TT – The end of match screen ranking is too difficult at the moment and includes old Control parameters. The reward system requires stat rebalancing and integrating with current gamemode objectives.
[*] Infinite Missiles – There is a rare instance where a game could go on forever, we’ve got some bits to do to catch this case, but they’ll be in for the next patch.
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.91 - The Frame Rate Fixer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/88f0ee584795661d0b803d1682f898ee96a767b3.png[/img]

Hey all, We've done some general full game optimization and players should see a decent increase in performance and fixed a number of bugs that you guys had highlighted through playtesting! Play around with your graphics settings, as you guys should now be able to go to higher qualities!

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mysterious Liquid now doesn't trigger on dead bodies.
[*] Mysterious liquid should now pick up instantly, instead of you having to walk on and off to trigger it.
[*] Dead bodies shouldn't block projectiles anymore.
[*] Changes to the Language Filter.
[*] Characters being flung off the map for seemingly no reason during play shouldn't happen anymore.
[*] There's now a kill volume under the map, so if they do fall of the map somehow, they won't fall forever.
[*] Xandark now won't sometimes get stuck in the ground when using backstab.
[*] Troopers Health bars should not go invisible anymore.
[*] Not being able to kick players from your squad should now be fixed.
[*] Players who have been kicked out of the squad would randomly appear in queue should be fixed.
[*] Various Queue Bug Issues.
[*] The enter button in spectator mode not initiating typing should be fixed.
[*] Troopers should no longer sometimes spawn invisible.
[*] Players should no longer time out after 1 hour of play; this manifested itself through bugged queues and squads not working.
[/list] 

[h2]Known Issues Backlog:[/h2]  
[list]
[*] Sometimes controls reset after binding your custom controls, we’re working on fixing this, but it’s a bit of a tricky one so bear with us.
[*] If you Fetch someone like Crow as she hookshots Trigger may get stuck temporarily.
[*] Troopers sometimes fire multiple projectiles.
[*] Pink/purple text appears when your team or the enemy team capture or start to take a point.
[*] Purple text sometimes appears when damaging enemies  	
[*] Escape key doesn’t always exit out of menus. (switching tabs fixes this)
[*] Occasionally ability aiming reticles are being left after using the ability
[*] 3D models of abilities are being left in the air. The abilities are still going off, it’s just a     	a copy of the ability 3D model is being left in the air.
[*] Occasionally abilities can be fired off twice.
[*] Sometimes players fail to connect to the game, so they are forced to restart. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8 - The Play with Your Friends Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/88f0ee584795661d0b803d1682f898ee96a767b3.png[/img]

Hey everyone, BadFox Eddie here with a massive patch! It took us 4 weeks to put everything together, but we’re proud to announce a much requested feature, Squad Queue!

The UI has also gotten a facelift and we’re adding in a lot of features for new players, so that they better understand the game on their first play experience.

If that's not enough, we also tossed a new map and a new splash screen!
[list]
[*] [b]Squad Queue[/b] – You can now queue up with your friends and play together.
[*] [b]New Map[/b] – The Asteroid Colony has now been added.
[*] [b]In-Game options menu[/b] – you can now change your options in game!
[*] [b]Clarity 4.0[/b] – we’re overhauling a bunch of ways information is given and adding quick in-game menus to help players get the information they need.
[*] [b]New Camera Angle[/b] – We’ve changed the camera angle, hope you like it.
[*] [b]New Splash Screen[/b] – A new splash screen has been put in at the start of the game, teasing the upcoming Story Features that will be coming in the future.

[/list]
Let’s dive into it!

[h2]Important Note: Re-bind your keys![/h2]

Because we've made a bunch of back-end changes this patch, players with custom key bindings will need to re-bind their preferred bindings in the options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/301fc852009b25e951f68997ed832fbb43c3fba5.png[/img]

[h3]Squad Queue[/h3]

The long awaited Squad Queue is now live! 
[list]
[*] You can now queue up with your friends to play in the same match together. 
[*] This runs off of your Steam friends list, so you’ll have to add randos through steam if you want to squad up with them. 
[*] Once you’ve added people to your party, have everyone ready up and you'll join the queue.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/6b88fb2379748f3d7a012d69e66b625d130bc8b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/97dbb7ed5c3a70382352355dc2493a89cfbf2eef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/410fd82aa0793924796c6d58bf3e9686cfb1d94c.png[/img]

[h2]Crash Course[/h2]
TL;DR: We’ve disabled the tutorial, [b][url=https://www.playsupersquad.com/super-squad-crash-course]You can now visit our web version here[/url]![/b]

[u]Context[/u]
[list]
[*] The game is evolving faster than our tutorial can keep up
[*] We’ve deprioritized fixing and rebuilding the in-game tutorial to focus on making the core experience better
[*] We’re pivoting to a web-based tutorial with content that can keep up with our patch-to-patch changes[/list]
[h3]In-Game Options Menu[/h3]
Pretty straightforward, you can now [i]change your controls and other settings mid-game[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/a91dfc49d2b348d30c2dac982f250e4f92fe2640.png[/img]

[h2]Clarity Overhaul[/h2]

We’ve revamped our UI to make what is going on with your Troopers clearer, while also adding and revamping some in-game menus so that players can get a better understanding of critical info.

[h2]UI Update[/h2]

Our UI has been overhauled to really reinforce the fact that you’re controlling 2 Troopers. 

[list]
[*] We’ve cut your allied troopers out of your HUD, so you can focus on your two troopers’ cooldowns and death timers
[*] We have also added a KDA above your Trooper info HUD, which shows your 2 troopers’ combined impact on the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/97775b3e17553cc368e8f9e1235df6784f3a7e6b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/01c17f0280867c29509e41cc795ab65ad2869281.png[/img]

[h2]Damage and Performance Clarity[/h2]

Everything on-screen was a bit too hectic, with numbers flying off everywhere and a lack of feedback when your Troopers received damage. To address this, we’ve made 3 main changes:

[list]
[*] Only damage you deal or receive will show up, so you’ll see numbers above enemy troopers when you hit them, and numbers above your troopers when they take damage
[*] New Particle Effects fly off from your Trooper’s Health/Armour/Shield section of the HUD to help you understand when you take damage.
[*] When your Primary Trooper now takes damage a black vignette will encroach on the edge of the screen to give you immediate feedback when you’re taking damage
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/c1f7550dbf6eef8f515724e2d0d611b371321049.png[/img]

[h3]Winning a Game[/h3]

A number of players initially didn’t understand how the scoring worked in Control, so we made a couple changes to make the scoring system easier to understand:
[list]
[*] VP totals now live in the top corners of the screen for easy reference in the heat of battle 
[*] We’ve also added Particle Effects and Text which shoots out from the VP bars to help players see when and why they’re losing VP in real-time.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/4806998b4e91cf4d6aa4b7e8266cdb6cd4eeab5e.png[/img]

[h3]Ability Feedback[/h3]
We heard a lot of feedback from players unsure of when their abilities are off cooldown. We’ve heard you and worked to make it crystal clear when abilities are prepped and ready.
[list]
[*] Cooldowns now feature numbered countdown in addition to the filling ability bar
[*] We’ve added color changes, animations, and sounds to help you know when your abilities are ready and when they’re super-charged.
[/list]
[h2]Additional Menus[/h2]

[h3]In-Game Learn to Play Overlay[/h3]
We’ve added a learn-to-play overlay in-game as a reference for new players
[list]
[*] There is a ? icon at the top right of the screen; this will bring up a brief introduction to the UI features
[*] There’s a second page with hints and tips to get new players started
[/list]

[h3]New In-Game Trooper Info Page.[/h3]
We’ve simplified the Trooper info page (C Key), to show the ability information of both of your Troopers at the same time.

[h3]Placeholder Scoreboard[/h3]
We’ve moved the players on each team to the TAB key. This will turn into a full scoreboard in the future, but now you can see who’s on which team more easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/4dd43423f0ddafa6eca28642bbec552ce242a15a.png[/img]

[h3]New Camera Angle[/h3]

We’ve brought the camera down and angled it up slightly to get you closer to the action and your troopers. We’re excited to hear your feedback about it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/2112ebdcff9cca77955262f5e9b3b3340b7aaa95.png[/img]

[h3]Main Menu Change[/h3]

The Main menu has been altered to accommodate Squad queue and prepare us for our next big patch, which will introduce skins and other content to the game

[h3]Splash Screen[/h3]

When you load up the game you’ll see our new splash screen which hints at the story behind the game that we’re currently working on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/88edd99bcb7770a29954f17b1c156dc06f6d9522.png[/img]

[h3]Asteroid Colony[/h3]

On the outer rims of space, far beyond most of civilization, lies the Asteroid Colony; a great place for both harvesting resources and grabbing fast food. Visit the gigantic excavator that takes two four-armed Aliens to operate, fuel up your ship on the landing platform, and don’t forget to stop and get some tasty grub – it’s fresh and live from the digging site.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/57fa02e839a8de86bc409bcadd7198d496c2c7a7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/0f318aac0fa02b136d503e86f94d7c9b3b5b1470.png[/img]

[h3]General[/h3]
All projectiles have been made larger. This will make it easier to hit your target and harder to blame the devs when you miss your target.

[h3]Tharlin[/h3]
We want to make Tharlin mains think twice before mindlessly burrowing head-first into a full team, so we dialed back his mine damage to give his opponents a fighting chance.

Minor Inconvenience
[list]
[*] Base damage nerfed from 140 to 120
[*] Super damage nerfed from 160 to 140
[/list]
[h3]Fang[/h3]
Fetch was dealing a bit too much damage, especially when super-powered, so we’ve taken some pop out of Fang’s pup while keeping the stun length untouched.
[list]
[*] Base damage nerfed from 250 to 220
[*] Super damage nerfed from 350 to 300
[/list]
[h3]Sarge[/h3]
Sarge’s basic attack does too much damage, especially when he stacked attack buffs, so we’re nerfing it. This is step one in a two-step process to walk his damage back, so expect some ability nerfs in future patches, Sarge mains.
[list]
[*] Gun damage reduces from 26 to 22
[/list]
[h3]Crow[/h3]
Crow is meant to be this sniper assassin, she was getting shredded a bit too easily, so we gave her health a small bump.
[list]
[*] Health buffed from 395 to 460
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] AUDIO SLIDER BUG IS NOW FIXED!!!!!!! OMGDFJKSDLJFKSDJFLSD
[*] Fixed the bug where Troopers sometimes were unable to use abilities.
[*] Tharlin no longer sometimes deploy multiple sets of mines.
[*] Sarge suppressive fire PFX no longer persisting after death.
[*] Fixed when Troopers sometimes stood up after they died and don’t play their animation.
[*] Fixed Fetch bugging out players animations.
[*] Splosion now fixed, so it does damage or heals when it should
[*] Squad select now shows the correct names and in the correct font and formatting.
[*] .exe icon now updated to the newest icon.
[*] The mouse now locks to the game window, so you won’t get tabbed out unintentionally.
[*] Further information about what is going on as you’re going into the main menu.
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players may occasionally receive a "fatal error" message when connecting to a match, followed by the game crashing. This is a server-side bug we're squashing, but there's no harm to your PC. Just restart the game and hop back in queue.
[*] Troopers may be flung uncontrollably around the map. It seems to be linked to movement abilities, like suppressive fire or fetch, but currently unknown what exactly is causing it.  	  	
[*] Troopers sometimes fire multiple projectiles.       	
[*] Pink/purple text appears when your team or the enemy team capture or start to take a point
[*] Escape key doesn’t always exit out of menus, but if you switch to a different menu tab it'll fix it.       	
[*] Lightning sometimes keeps on triggering in the squad select screen          	
[*] Sometimes Troopers models disappear and only their overhead UI can be seen. If this happens their health/armour/shield numbers will not show.   	
[*] Occasionally ability aiming reticles are being left after using the ability          	
[*] 3D models of abilities are ocassionally being left in the air. The abilities are still going off normally, but a copy of the model will sometimes persist.
[*] Occasionally abilities can be fired off twice.
[/list]

tags.feature: - Squad Queue – You can now queue up with your friends and play together.
- New Map – The Asteroid Colony has now been added.
- In-Game options menu – you can now change your options in game!
- Clarity 4.0 – we’re overhauling a bunch of ways information is given and adding quick in-game menus to help players get the information they need.
- New Camera Angle – We’ve changed the camera angle, hope you like it.
- New Splash Screen – A new splash screen has been put in at the start of the game, teasing the upcoming Story Features that will be coming in the future.
- You can now queue up with your friends to play in the same match together.
Pretty straightforward, you can now change your controls and other settings mid-game!
- We’ve cut your allied troopers out of your HUD, so you can focus on your two troopers’ cooldowns and death timers
- We have also added a KDA above your Trooper info HUD, which shows your 2 troopers’ combined impact on the game.
- Only damage you deal or receive will show up, so you’ll see numbers above enemy troopers when you hit them, and numbers above your troopers when they take damage
- New Particle Effects fly off from your Trooper’s Health/Armour/Shield section of the HUD to help you understand when you take damage.
- When your Primary Trooper now takes damage a black vignette will encroach on the edge of the screen to give you immediate feedback when you’re taking damage
- VP totals now live in the top corners of the screen for easy reference in the heat of battle
- We’ve also added Particle Effects and Text which shoots out from the VP bars to help players see when and why they’re losing VP in real-time.
- Cooldowns now feature numbered countdown in addition to the filling ability bar
- We’ve added color changes, animations, and sounds to help you know when your abilities are ready and when they’re super-charged.
- There is a ? icon at the top right of the screen; this will bring up a brief introduction to the UI features
- There’s a second page with hints and tips to get new players started
We’ve simplified the Trooper info page (C Key), to show the ability information of both of your Troopers at the same time.
We’ve moved the players on each team to the TAB key.
We’ve brought the camera down and angled it up slightly to get you closer to the action and your troopers.
When you load up the game you’ll see our new splash screen which hints at the story behind the game that we’re currently working on.
The Asteroid Colony has now been added.

tags.balance_change: All projectiles have been made larger.

tags.bug: - AUDIO SLIDER BUG IS NOW FIXED!!!!!!! OMGDFJKSDLJFKSDJFLSD
- Fixed the bug where Troopers sometimes were unable to use abilities.
- Tharlin no longer sometimes deploy multiple sets of mines.
- Sarge suppressive fire PFX no longer persisting after death.
- Fixed when Troopers sometimes stood up after they died and don’t play their animation.
- Fixed Fetch bugging out players animations.
- Splosion now fixed, so it does damage or heals when it should
- Squad select now shows the correct names and in the correct font and formatting.
- .exe icon now updated to the newest icon.
- The mouse now locks to the game window, so you won’t get tabbed out unintentionally.
- Further information about what is going on as you’re going into the main menu.

notes.title: Patch Notes - The Control Freak Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/88f0ee584795661d0b803d1682f898ee96a767b3.png[/img]

Hi Troopers, BadFox Eddie here. We’ve got some exciting things coming this patch that I think you guys are going to love! 
[list]
[*] Shoot-em-up (SHMUP) Buffs - Stacking damage/bullet and utility/stat buffs that individual Troopers will be able to pick up from devices that drop in from the sky
[*] Trooper Controls and Commands - Our controls 2.0 and Trooper movement updates add some interesting ways to customise your playing experience and move your troopers around the map. 
[*] Map Updates! We’ve got a new map, Military Base! We’ve also tweaked the layouts of all current maps to accommodated SHMUP Buffs[/list]
I’m really excited to see what you guys think of the new core gameplay mechanic, it’s been a lot of fun to make and test out for the upcoming patch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/301fc852009b25e951f68997ed832fbb43c3fba5.png[/img]

[h2]SHMUP Buffs[/h2]
A new core gamemode feature is being added: shoot-em-up buffs. These consist of stacking damage/bullet and utility/stat buffs that individual Troopers will be able to pick up from devices that drop in from the sky:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/d2aef3d710e53c41b648ba53cdf722d2afd5942e.png[/img]

Here are the details:
[list]
[*] Troopers can only have one buff type at a time and they lose all of their buffs when they die, so make sure to watch who’s got what on each team to know who to kill or stay away from.
[*] Buffs will be dropped on the map at regular intervals, assuming that previously dropped buffs have been collected. 
[*] Both teams will be alerted prior to their landing and will be able to compete to deplete the buff pod’s health bar
[*] The first team to deplete the health bar will have a buff dropped for them and the first trooper of that team to walk over the buff will be awarded it. 
[/list]
Be aware that high damage troopers can steal the buff, so watch your surroundings and you might have to prioritise enemies given the situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/14295c783ed9165ec70fd0e883ac860ed359d06f.png[/img]

[h3]Damage/Bullet buffs[/h3]

Tier 1
[b]Ricochet Bullets[/b] - If a Trooper's bullet hits an enemy Trooper, a secondary bullet will spawn on impact, shooting at an enemy within their max gun range from the affected enemy Trooper.

Tier 2
[b]Piercing Bullets[/b] – if a Trooper hits an enemy Trooper their bullets will pass through them up until their maximum gun range. It will also spawn a ricochet bullet in the same way as tier 1.

Tier 3
[b]Laser Bullets[/b] – an additional laser beam will be fired, in addition to their piercing projectile, which covers their whole gun range. Like the previous tiers they are blocked by environmental objects. It will also spawn a ricochet bullet like tier 2, however, the shot will be a piercing bullet.

[h3]Utility/Stat Buffs[/h3]
	
Tier 1 	
[b]Chonky Shot[/b] – Trooper bullets are now 25% larger.
 
Tier 2 	
[b]Slow Down Shot[/b] – if a Trooper’s bullet hits an enemy Trooper, the enemy’s movement speed will be slowed by 20% for 1 second, this effect does not stack. 
Tier 1 effects will also be applied.
 
Tier 3
[b]Speed Up Shot[/b] – if a Trooper’s bullet hits an enemy Trooper the trooper who fired the 	shot will have their movement speed increased by 10% for 1 second, this effect does not stack. Tier 1 and 2 effects will also be applied.

[h2]Trooper Controls & Commands Update[/h2]

We’ve given you a couple of new ways to command your second trooper around the map!

[b]Custom Controls 2.0[/b]

We’ve gone through some clarity and UX exercises in our controls menu to allow you guys to be able to change and customise your preferred controls more easily to your playstyle. You can now change key bindings more freely, binding already used keys to new bindings. You will have to have all keys bound in the menu and save them before being able to continue.

We’re also changing controls to allow you to set if your ‘relative’ controls are for movement, abilities, or both. E.g. you could keep your abilities as set or default, while having your movement commands switch as you switch between Troopers. We heard from a number of players that this was a feature that they wanted, so we’ve pushed this through to give you guys a better playing experience.

[b]Trooper Commands[/b]

[b]Auto-Follow[/b] - By pressing the G key (default keybinding), you will toggle an auto-follow command for your secondary trooper. The Trooper will follow you until they die or are given a new movement command. This will help you keep your team together without having to micro-manage them as much -- but be careful, this means that your troopers will be easy to predict and very vulnerable to AoE abilities.

[b]Patrol Paths[/b] - You can also draw paths for your Troopers to patrol. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/a5fbf4271361bc599db2c48936001005c4babbdd.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Press your move command key (default Q or E), and drag your mouse across the map. 
[*] When you release the move command the Trooper will then path along that line.
[/list]
This makes moving your troopers around the map a lot more fluid, meaning you can perform pincer maneuvers on the way into the fight without having to stop firing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/4dd43423f0ddafa6eca28642bbec552ce242a15a.png[/img]

[b]Animations[/b]
Florp, Flintlock, and Fang all have updated in game and menu animations to give them more character.

[b]Control Point Clarity[/b]
We’ve also removed the outside circles from control points to really focus on the capture zone themselves. We found that some new players were standing in the outer regions of control points expecting to capture them. They were originally placed to cover more of the map so players had an easier time orienting themselves around the map, however, with the addition of the mini-map this feature has now become redundant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/88edd99bcb7770a29954f17b1c156dc06f6d9522.png[/img]

[b]Map Layout Changes[/b]
Every map layout has been adjusted to accommodate Buff drop locations

[b]Map Release:[/b]
The Military Base: “The most secure training facility this side of the moon, this well-equipped base was the central hub of the Military Faction – that is until other Factions started appearing. New recruits come here both to practice and fight off invaders, so challenge yourself to the obstacle course, hunker down by the pillbox and bunkers, or battle over the tank depot.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/78b068d8528b1cfb886c22fd99e4b5117d5ee86f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/d68884771205f545d0107a5663f98d6f2009cb06.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/0f318aac0fa02b136d503e86f94d7c9b3b5b1470.png[/img]

[b]Sarge:[/b]
Sarge was doing a bit too much damage and was a bit too hard to kill  in our last patch, so we’ve nerfed cluster grenade and suppressive fire to bring him more in line with the other Troopers.

Cluster grenade
[list][*] Shots per super meter: nerfed from 20 to 30
[*] Base damage is staying the same, however;[list][*] Empowered inner damage nerfed from 150 to 130
[*] Empowered outer damage nerfed from 170 to 150[/list]
[*] Range nerfed from 35m to 22.5m
[*] Cooldown nerfed from 12 to 15 seconds[/list]
Suppressive Fire
[list][*]Damage reduction reduced from 60% to 45%[/list]
[b]Skull Crusher:[/b]
We found that Skull Crusher’s supercharged Anchors away was a bit lack-luster, so it’s been given a buff.

Anchors Away
[list]
[*] Supercharged Anchors Away has been buffed from 240 damage to 320[/list]
[b]Nebular:[/b]
We found that Neb was being a bit too strong when paired with certain Trooper’s like Sarge and Crow. With the coming SHMUP buffs we saw this getting out of hand, so he’s been slightly nerfed to reflect the upcoming changes.

Focus
[list]
[*] Damage buff nerfed from 50% to 40%
[*] Super charged buff nerfed from 65% to 60%
[/list]
[b]Scorch[/b]
We’ve found that a lot of players were running away from oncoming friendly Rain of Fires, so we’ve added some visualisation before the fireball lands to help players understand if it’s dangerous or not.

Rain of Fire
[list]
[*] After rain of fire has been cast a friend or foe outer area visualisation has been added to give players more feedback as to what team it belongs to.
[*] Super charged Rain of Fire damage buffed from 60 to 80
[/list]
[b]Florp[/b]
Forp’s been given some number tweaks to the damage and healing parts of splosion, his empowered damage was waaaay too high and his initial damage was a bit low. With the Flintlock healing nerf we’ve also bumped his healing amount we’ve also increased to super charged version of splosion’s heal to compensate.

Splosion
[list]
[*] Damage buffed from 180 to 220
[*] Super charged damage nerfed from 300 to 250
[*] Super charged heal buffed from 400 to 450
[/list]
Transfusion
[list]
[*] Lifesteal nerfed from 55% to 45
[*] Super charged lifesteal buffed from 55% to 60
[/list]
[b]Tharlin[/b]
We found that the last nerf to tharlin was a bit too much, he’d lost the capability to burst people down as effectively as they have more warning that he’s comin. We’ve buffed his damage to reflect this. Now if you land the hit you’ll not only feel like you’ve earned it, but you’ll also do a lot more damage!
[list]
[*] Damage buffed from 110 to 150
[/list]
[b]Flintlock[/b]
Flintlock was being really annoying to kill, his mysterious liquid was healing him for too much too often and the damage reduction from Double O’d was a bit too strong, so we’ve made some changes to reflect that.

Mysterious Liquid 
[list]
[*] Base heal amount nerfed from 280 to 200
[*] Empowered heal amount nerfed from 380 to 320
[/list]
Double O’s 
[list]
[*] Damage reduction nerfed from 25% to 15%
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes: [/h2]
[list]
[*] "Would you recommend the game?" prompt has now been reverted to the original method - no longer as spammy
[*] Fixed bug where Troopers were not adhering to their designated ‘hits to charge super charge bar’ numbers.

[/list]
[h2]Known Issues:[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Audio Slider bug not currently changing audio in game – we’re really trying to fix this, it’s 	just throwing problem after problem with a 3rd party 	plugin we’re using.	
[*] Troopers may be flung uncontrollably around the map. It seems to be linked to movement abilities, like suppressive fire or fetch, but currently unknown what exactly is causing it. 	
[*] Troopers sometimes fire multiple projectiles.
[*] Pink/purple text appears when your team or the enemy team capture or start to take a point.
[*] Sometimes troopers are unable to use abilities. (switch characters to get around this issue)
[*] Escape key doesn’t always exit out of menus. (switching tabs fixes this)
[*] Trooper sometimes stand up when they die and don’t play their animation
[*] Tharlin can sometimes deploy multiple sets of mines
[*] Lightning sometimes keeps on triggering in the squad select screen
[*] Sometimes Troopers models disappear and only their overhead UI can be seen.
[*] Occasionally ability aiming reticles are being left after using the ability
[*] 3D models of abilities are being left in the air. The abilities are still going off, it’s just a 	a copy of the ability 3D model is being left in the air.
[*] Occasionally abilities can be fired off twice.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: The Sound and The Fury Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/88f0ee584795661d0b803d1682f898ee96a767b3.png[/img]

Hi everyone! BadFox Eddie here, with a patch fully loaded with features, updates, and a new trooper!
Here’s a quick breakdown of what to expect in this upcoming patch:
[list]
[*] Minimap - See the whole map, including your allies and any enemies in their field of vision
[*] Clarity Part 3 - The final step of our clarity patch, updating sounds for all guns, abilities, and ambience, along with a final coat of visual polish
[*] Glorgan joins the Squad - Glorgan brings a new type of front-line support to the battlefield
[/list]
We have been and will continue to, collect feedback regarding clarity, so make sure to join in on the Q&A after Friday’s playtest in our Discord Server or anything else you want to talk to the devs about! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/301fc852009b25e951f68997ed832fbb43c3fba5.png[/img]

[h2]Minimap[/h2]

Today we’re rolling out a new feature for players – the minimap. With this we hope that you guys will be able to see what’s going on around the map more clearly and strategies with your team more through the chat feature we put in last patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/bbd44052b7f9018b001f26f5008912da58cbd9d4.jpg[/img]

Some key features of the minimap:
[list]
[*] Allies will always be visible on the minimap
[*] When an ally takes damage they will pulse on the minimap
[*] Enemies will be visible when they come into any ally’s field of vision
[*] Control points will be visible on the map, with filling or emptying team specific colours
[/list]
With the implementation of the minimap, we are removing the edge of the screen UI in order to consolidate player focus on one place when they want to look, instead of having to scan around the edge of the entire screen.

[h2]Sound Update[/h2] 

All sound has been overhauled in the game. There are additional and improved sounds for levels and Troopers and volumes have been rebalanced to give a better and more immersive playing experience.
Sounds have been attenuated to allow players to understand where and what is going on around them by audio queues alone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/dc6adf0e8b5d55565c056edac07ae2272daf720a.png[/img]

[h2]Glorgan[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/72075ed438c1a645bd09beacb84fd0d3ec146871.gif[/img]

Glorgan is the culmination of Alien tech – a huge, unstoppable piece of machinery armed with a Laser Cannon and rallying beacon. Built specially to defend Nebular from both enemies and overzealous fans, Glorgan’s defensive capabilities will keep your Squad safe from harm and enable them to run away or engage with extreme velocity.

[b]Stats[/b]

[u]Defensive[/u]
Health – 750 
Shield – 750 
[u]Damage[/u]
Shots for super charge – 6
Damage per Attack – 60 
Damage Variance – 8 
Range – 27m 
Projectile Speed – 10500 
Accuracy – 3000
Attack Speed – 1.67/s 
On Hit CDR – 0.6

[u][b]Abilities[/b][/u]

[b]Overcharge[/b]: Glorgan overcharges their shield, gaining an additional 50% of its maximum value for 10 seconds. If the shield becomes depleted within the 10 seconds then it explodes, dealing 320 damage to enemies within 10m.
[list]
[*] % Shield Increase - 50%
[*] Shield Increase Duration - 10s
[*] Explosion Damage - 320
[*] Effect Area - 10m
[*] Cooldown - 13s
[/list]
Super Stats:
[list][*] % Shield Increase - 60%
[*] Explosion Damage - 380
[/list]
[b]Rallying Call[/b]: Glorgan emits a wave from his beacon, rallying all friendly Troopers within 10m. Rallied Troopers receive a damage and movement speed buff of 15% for 15 seconds.
[list]
[*] Effect Diameter	- 10m
[*] Buff Duration - 10s
[*] Speed % Increase - 15%
[*] % Damage Reduction - 15%
[*] Cooldown - 15s
[/list]
Super Stats
[list]
[*] Speed % Increase - 20%
[*] % Damage Reduction - 30%
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/4dd43423f0ddafa6eca28642bbec552ce242a15a.png[/img]

[h2]Animation updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tharlin: has been scaled down to be his appropriate size, however, hitbox is unchanged. 
[*] Nebular: all in game and menu animations have been updated. 
[*] Crow: all in game and menu animations have been updated. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/0f318aac0fa02b136d503e86f94d7c9b3b5b1470.png[/img]

[b]Super Meter 2.0[/b]
All troopers can now charge their Super Meter while any of their abilities are on cooldown. Once the meter is full, the next ability will have added effects like more damage or more range!
But Beware! If you use an ability while your meter is partially full you’ll lose the meter you’ve built up, so watch your meter and make sure not to waste it!

[b]Sarge[/b]
Shots to charge super meter: 20 

[b]Crow[/b]
Shots to charge super meter: 4 

[b]Skull Crusher[/b]
We felt like the battlefield needed more headbutts and SC agreed, so we dropped its cooldown.
Shots to charge super meter: 11
Charge (buff) - Cooldown decreased from 10 to 8 

[b]Nebular[/b]
Focus was fizzling on allies if the cursor wasn’t exactly on them, so now it’ll be available until you land it on an ally
Shots to charge super meter: 7 
Focus (Quality of Life) -  No longer goes on cooldown if you miss the ability

[b]Scorch[/b]
Shots to charge super meter: 6 

[b]Florp[/b]
Like Focus, Transfusion was fizzling without helping anyone, now it won’t activate until you land it!
Shots to charge super meter: 10 
Transfusion (Quality of Life) - No longer goes on cooldown if you miss the ability

[b]Tharlin[/b]
Shots to charge super meter: 4 

[b]Fang[/b]
Shots to charge super meter: 5 

[b]Flintlock [/b]
We noticed Flintlock has been a one-person army, so we toned down their damage and healing capabilities
Shots to charge super meter: 4 
Double O’s (Nerf) - Initial Damage decreased from 150 to 100
Mysterious Liquid (Nerf) - Heal decreased from 320 to 280

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed character rotation on squad select, so now everyone is facing the right way.
[*] Fixed a bug where some death animations were not working
[*] Fixed a bug where Scorch wasn’t being interrupted correctly during Rain of Fire
[*] Flintlock now has a weapon sound
[*] Fixed a bug where Tharlin placed too many mines
[*] Fixed a bug where Crow could hook shot into broken areas of the map
[*] Fixed Knockback shot not firing straight after hookshot
[*] Fixed a bug where Spam ability stopping you from using abilities until switch 
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues: [/h2]
[olist]
[*] Sometimes a pink message appears for a split second on the screen (In place of capture flag message)
[*] Sometimes bullets come out in a burst
[*] Sometimes abilities are locked off from use (Switch characters to get around the issue for now)
[*] Escape key doesn’t always work on menus (Switching tabs will fix this temporarly)
[*] Sometimes Troopers will not animate when they die, staying standing.
[*] Occasionally Tharlin will deploy multiple sets of mines 
[*] Lightning Keeps retriggering when other characters select characters on unit select
[*] Troopers can occasionally lose their model, meaning that only their overhead UI can be seen.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes: The Pretty Particles Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/88f0ee584795661d0b803d1682f898ee96a767b3.png[/img]

Hi Troopers, BadFoX Eddie here. Today’s patch revolves around 4 distinct things:
[list]
[*] [b]In-Game Chat[/b] - A new in-game chat which will allow people on the same team to message each other while they’re in the match,
[*] [b]New particle effects[/b] - All current Troopers’ abilities and bullets have new visuals
[*] [b]Post-game Feedback[/b] - After each match you will be fielded a question of “Would you recommend Super Squad to a friend?” We’ll use your feedback to help make the game as great as it can be.
[*] [b]Urban Battleground[/b] - A new map that brings the fight to an urban city center
[/list]
As always, [url=https://trello.com/b/86wFGFUX/super-squad-roadmap]our development roadmap is open to the public -- check it out[/url] to see what's coming up in future patches, as well as some known issues to be aware of.

Let’s dive in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/301fc852009b25e951f68997ed832fbb43c3fba5.png[/img]

[h2]In-game Chat[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/b0c8b2fbaedc848816373d37b5b07fdc2449bb24.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Players can now communicate while in-game.
[*] /All chat is currently turned off, but this will be coming in the near future.
[*] The ‘emote’ system is still active and bound to the TAB key.
[/list]
[h2]Post-Game Feedback[/h2]
[list]
[*] Every post-game screen asks “Would you recommend the game to a friend?” with a yes/no response
[*] This feedback gives us a general idea of whether we’re heading in the right direction, so the more responses, the better we can improve the game
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/4dd43423f0ddafa6eca28642bbec552ce242a15a.png[/img]

All Troopers are going to be getting new and updated particle effects:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/155adff29f83db2cabf9b874340d9a45b952ed9f.gif[/img]
[list][*]Abilities - All abilities have been updated with fancy new particles, and abilities like Florp’s splosion grenades are clearly colored to show green or red for ally or enemy[*]Bullets - All bullets will now reflect trooper damage type[list][*]Blue - Strong against Shield
[*]Orange - Strong against Armor
[*]Red - Strong against Health[/list][*]Rain of Fire and Battleflag now have Enemy and Ally Visual markers to assist with recognition[/list]
The aim here is making it clearer who you want to prioritise out of the enemy Troopers and remove confusion over whether an ability was used by your team or the enemy team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/88edd99bcb7770a29954f17b1c156dc06f6d9522.png[/img]

[h2]Urban Battleground is live![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/111169791cc30f876149950d8427112f7f98e0c9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/0f318aac0fa02b136d503e86f94d7c9b3b5b1470.png[/img]

[b]Crow:[/b]
We wanted to reward Crow players for strong decision-making with Hookshot by giving them more options, so she can now fly in from anywhere, not just an arbitrary range. To balance, we’re upping the cooldown on this powerful repositioning tool.

[i]Hookshot[/i] 
[list]
[*] Range removed, meaning that you can use it from anywhere.
[*] Cooldown increased from 12s to 18s
[/list]
[b]Tharlin:[/b]
We heard your feedback on everyone’s favorite beardy boi and his ability to burrow on top of someone and one-shot them with Minor Inconvenience, so we reduced the damage on his mines, and increased the time it takes for him to Burrow from Point A to Point B, so players can C themselves out of a bad situation.

[i]Burrow[/i]
[list]
[*] Travel time of Tharlin’s increased from 1 second to 2 seconds
[/list]
[i]Minor Inconvenience[/i]
[list]
[*] Damage decreased from 140 to 110
[/list]
[b]Nebular:[/b]
We wanted to reward players for choosing when to attack and when to defend, so Nebular’s abilities will reflect that. Focus is already all about the DPS, so we’ve buffed Psionic Wave to better shield a team in defensive situations.

[i]Psionic Wave –[/i] 
[list]
[*] Defensive buff increased from 30% to 35%
[*] Damage buff reduced from 20% to 15%
[/list]
[b]Flintlock:[/b]
The damage over time was lasting waaaay too long and resulting in a lot of cheap deaths, so we nerfed it.

[i]Double O’s[/i]
[list]
[*] DoT duration reduced from 8 seconds to 5 seconds.
[/list]
[b]Skull Crusher:[/b]
We hit Reserves hard a couple patches back to stop Raid Boss Skullcrusher from holding a point solo while bullet sponging an entire team. Now he’s melting too fast, so we’re slightly buffing reserves to activate at a higher health % to reward intelligent damage soaking.

[i]Reserves[/i]
[list]
[*] Health threshold trigger increased from 10% to 20%
[/list]
[b]Fang:[/b]
We’ve made Fang’s core combo of slow-and-snatch easier to land by increasing Smoke Bomb’s slow. Since you’ll be landing more Fetches, we’re dialing back its damage and the Slow duration to narrow the window of opportunity.

[i]Smoke Bomb[/i]
[list]
[*] Duration nerfed from 6s to 4s
[*] Slow % buffed from 30% to 40%
[/list]
[i]Fetch[/i]
[list]
[*] Damage nerfed to 250 from 300
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Flintlock can no longer travel through object while using Double O's
[*]Ragdoll Simulation now added correctly to everything that does explosive / special damage (Abilities only). That means lots more flying bodies across the map!!![/list]

That's it for this patch! Check out our [url=https://trello.com/b/86wFGFUX/super-squad-roadmap]check out our roadmap[/url] to get some insight into what's coming down the pipe.
