notes.title: Patch Notes - The Visual Update Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Overview[/h2]

Hi Troopers, BadFox Eddie here. Today we’re releasing the character visual overhaul with the aim to give all our Troopers more style and personality. Everyone who’s currently available has had new animations and models, with particle effects soon to follow. We’re also doing some minor bug fixes across the board to help make the game as fluid as possible for everyone.

[h2]Art Update[/h2]

All Troopers now have high poly models, giving them more character and personality. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1124940/view/2420069741605324375]See the full update article over here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/29c55947dac02fec2bfdff5601b79b743bedd88c.png[/img]

[h2]Trooper Releases: Tharlin[/h2]

At any given moment Tharlin would rather be underground, sitting amongst his treasure and drinking his favourite mead. Having grown up with nine siblings, he is fiercely competitive and will stop at nothing to achieve victory. Those who underestimate him based on his short stature quickly find themselves regretting it – his habit of tunnel hopping makes him a difficult target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257632/2ca73854eed7ab69bf3164f77945dd53348c5551.png[/img]

[h3]Stats:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health – 525 
[*] Shield – 450 
[*] Damage per Attack – 108 
[*] Damage Variance – 15 
[*] Range – 40m 
[*] Projectile Speed – 8250 
[*] Accuracy – 4000
[*] Attack Speed – 1.25/s 
[*] On Hit CDR – 0.8 
[*] Super Charge – 0.8
[*] Super Damage – 300
[*] Super Heal – 400
[/list]

[h3]Abilities[/h3]

[b]Burrow[/b]
Tharlin burrows underground, creating a tunnel between himself and a target location within a 40m radius. If the ability button is held down, an expanding area appears around Tharlin in which allies can also travel with him; for each ally, the next Burrow cooldown increases.
[list]
[*] Range - 40m
[*] Effect Diameter - 10m
[*] Wind Up Time - <=3s
[*] Increased Cooldown/Unit - 5s
[*] Cooldown - 16s
[/list]

[b]Minor Inconvenience[/b]
Tharlin dashes forwards 11m, leaving a trail of mines in his wake. Enemies that come close to the mines trigger them, causing an AoE explosion which deals 160 damage. These mines persist for 40 seconds, or until destroyed by an ability.
Range - 11m
[list]
[*] Explosion Effect Diameter - 4m
[*] Number of Mines Dropped - 5
[*] Mine Trigger Diameter - 2m
[*] Unit Speed - 5m/s
[*] Explosion DMG Per Mine - 140
[*] Cooldown - 15s
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[b]All Troopers[/b]
Each auto attack will now charge the super bar twice as fast - Players were having trouble charging up their super bar in the last playtest, so we’ve rocket-fueled the charge rate

[b]Scorch[/b]

[u]Rain of Fire[/u]

DoT duration reduced to 3 seconds from 5 – Considering that there is no way to get rid of DoT effects currently, we felt that the DoT was lasting too long and doing too much damage for the lack of risk Scorch had to put himself into.

[b]Flintlock[/b]

[u]Double O’s[/u]

Damage reduction reduced from 60% to 25% – Before, Flintlock could tank a lot of damage while applying his hard-hitting DoT, which we felt was too powerful. Now Flintlock players will have to be more strategic with their abilities before jumping into a pile of enemies.

[b]Florp[/b]

[u]Splosion[/u]

Reduced damage of Splosion from 210 to 180 – We thought the damage was waaaay too high for a healer, so we’ve scaled it down to be less dominating in team fights.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rewrote matchmaking code to use database and fixed the connection issue (waiting for 1 player)
[*] Changed server offline message to read from database so we can change it without doing a new build
[*] Changed disconnect code to stop the server closing if people were slow to join
[*] UI transition bug fixes
[*] Name display fix for squad select
[*] Updated to new character models on squad select screen with updated layout
[*] Continue notifier ticks for end match screen
[*] Fixed erroneously ending game sessions early when somebody disconnects from the game
[*] Fixed quick match button for when disconnected
[*] Disabled old invisible but clickable background UI
[*] Fixed mismatch of player names and units on squad select
[*] Adjusted gradient on squad select to show correct colours between the top and bottom of what's visible
[*] Fixed burning FX for ragdolled units
[*] Fixed counter for queue wait time
[*] Fixed unit selection order
[*] Health / Armour / Shield Numbers now displaying correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Super Squad Patch Notes: The Game Pacing Patch!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Super Squad Patch Notes: The Game Pacing Patch![/b]
[/h2]
[h3][b]Overview[/b]
[/h3]
Hello, Troopers! It’s BadFoxEddie here with patch notes for the upcoming Super Squad patch. We’re calling it the ‘Game Pacing Patch,’ and as the name suggests, a big focus from the design team this patch was on speeding up gaming pacing a bit, both in-game and in queue.

We heard feedback from players that ever since our pivot to 3v3 team-based gameplay, special abilities felt like they were taking a little too long to cool down between uses, making for some unintended stalling strategies to wait out the downtime. 

So this patch, we’ve introduced a new [b]cooldown reduction [/b]mechanic:
[list][*]Every time you hit an enemy with a basic shot, your abilities’ cooldown timers reduce.[*]Most Troopers have received a base cooldown rate reduction, so let those abilities rip![*]Ability damage has been reduced in some cases to account for newfound spammability.[/*][/list]
In short, we’re making it easier to spam game-changing special abilities — but you’ve got to earn it by aiming well. We’re excited to hear your feedback on these changes! 

Speaking of changes, patch notes below!

[h3][b]Trooper Balance[/b]
[/h3]
Scorch

“Scorch was holding points a little too easily on his own, so we toned down his individual power”
[list][*]0.5 CDR on hit[*]Rain of Fire [list] [*]Range down to 30m from 40m [*]Explosion Damage down from 180m to 140m [*]DoT down to 30m from 35m[/*] [/list][*]Deploy Turret [list] [*]Throw range down to 15m from 20m [*]Damage per shot decreased from 10m to 8m[/*] [/list][/*] [/list]
Sarge
[list][*]0.2 CDR on hit[*]Cluster Grenade [list] [*]Range down to 25m from 40m[/*] [/list][/*] [/list]
Crow
[list][*]0.9 CDR on hit[*]Knockback Shot [list] [*]Range decreased to 30m from 35m [*]Knockback distance down to 15m from 25m[/*] [/list][/*] [/list]
 Skull Crusher
[list][*]0.3 CDR on hit[*]Gun range down to 26m from 35m[*]Reserves [list] [*]Cooldown increase to 18 seconds from 15[/*] [/list][/*] [/list]
Nebular
[list][*]0.4 CDR on hit[*]Focus [list] [*]Range increase to 35m from 30m[/*] [/list][/*] [/list]
Florp
[list][*]0.3 CDR on hit[*]Splosion [list] [*]Damage down to 280 from 350[/*] [/list][/*] [/list]
Fang
[list][*]0.7 CDR on hit[*]Gun Range increase to 26m from 22m [list] [*]Smoke Bomb [*]Range down to 25m from 30m[/*] [/list][/*] [/list]
 Flintlock
[list][*]0.4 CDR on hit[*]Mysterious Liquid [list] [*]Range up to 25m from 22m [*]Cooldown increase to 15 seconds from 12[/*] [/list][/*] [/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous[/b]
[/h3][list][*]In-Game [list] [*]We’ve added [b]damage types[/b] to the user interface, so players can more easily see whether they need to be damaging armor or shields against a given enemy [*]We moved Capture Point messages to just above the HUD [*][b]Floating guns[/b] that haunted some players’ menu screens has been removed[/*] [/list][*]All abilities and Troopers should now have [b]correct descriptions in the Trooper tab[/b] (old ones were very outdated)[*]We changed the way [b]control point capture sounds[/b] worked; looking for feedback on the new sound effects![*]Tutorial [list] [*]Fixed bug in tutorial that wouldn’t move onto Cluster Grenade Ability [/*] [/list][*]Find Match Queue [list] [*]Streamlined game queues, where players will automatically rejoin queue if one player in their game disconnects before Game Start [*]Fixed an issue where some players couldn’t disconnect while in queue [*]Added Timer to Find Match Screen  [*]Added Tips to Find Match screen Refactoring - General [/*] [/list][/*] [/list]
